root_cause_classes.name: Instruments that report green without measuring — guards shipped without a control, and acknowledgement layers that age without a staleness rule
root_cause_classes.thesis: The platform counts gates, not proofs. `scripts/gate_census.py` today: 597 gates, 50 proven able to fail, 538 unproven, 49 vacuous-empty, 33 swallowed-exit. `/prove-it` names the shape ('a thing that reports success without having done its job') and is a discretionary read; the principal verdict measured 35 of 101 recent source-scanning guards with no positive control. Specimens: both AI judges turned a missing verdict into 'ok' (AIQ-2), the canary-precision check produced a chronic WARN for 30+ days instead of a number (OBS-1), an Errors alarm sized by copy above its surface's traffic (CTO-2), a count-≥1 alarm that mutes itself for 14 days (OBS-5), a grader whose only test mocks the grader (CPO-2), the a11y ledger disarming itself in the good direction (a11y-3), a green-reader treating `cancelled` as no signal (DEVEX-1), a read-only contract asserted by the phrase '--apply' (DEVEX-6). The acknowledgement layers on top decay the same way: the wrap's (e10) citation gate matches alarm NAME to entry — a citation written 09-01 for a cured cause stayed green over a new cause lit 09-03 (CTO-3/OBS-2); the remediation agent's needs-human lines repeat verbatim with no terminal condition (OBS-3). This through-line has been the session finding for F, G, P, Q, R and U — six sessions — and remains a memory topic.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: There is no gate on gates: a new test/check/alarm enters the tree with no requirement that it carry a mutation proof; the census derives the `unproven` number but nothing ratchets it; `/prove-it` and `/new-machinery` are skills the author may or may not invoke; the citation gate's rules are existence + issue-openness + wording, never timestamp or cause; the a11y ledger has a shrink path with no consumer.

prevention.what: (1) The census `unproven`/`vacuous-empty`/`swallowed-exit` counts become CI ratchets (shrink-only, dated exemptions) — a PR that adds a gate must add its proof fixture in the same diff or a dated `unproven` entry with a reason; this is the ONE place the six-session lesson becomes enforcement. (2) `check_alarm_citations.py` gains the structural staleness rule (citation.added ≥ the alarm's StateTransitionedTimestamp, else FAIL) and a `cause` field compared to the live check id / StateReason; the remediation agent refuses to store an ack whose conclusion asserts resolution while the metric still breaches. (3) `tests/test_a11y_audit.py` reds on any serious/critical ledger entry with no `issue` field (the #2956 truth-ledger rule reused) and the wrap battery reads the latest visual-qa shrink artifact and reds on candidates older than 7 days. (4) `tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py`: no Errors alarm may carry a threshold above its surface's measured median hourly traffic without a dated registry entry.
prevention.where: scripts/gate_census_enforcement.py (ratchet on the three counters), tests/test_gate_census_ratchet.py, scripts/check_alarm_citations.py (+ docs/alarm_citations.json `cause`), remediation/agent.py (ack refusal), tests/test_a11y_audit.py, scripts/wrap_gates.py (shrink-artifact read), tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py; .claude/skills/prove-it/SKILL.md gets a one-line pointer to the ratchet as its enforcement
prevention.negative_control: Add `tests/test_new_scanner.py` that greps source with no must-fail case → `unproven` +1 → ratchet reds in CI; add the mutation fixture → green. Cite `qa-smoke-failures` with `added: 2026-09-01`, then feed a StateTransitionedTimestamp of 2026-09-03 → gate FAILs; re-cite dated today → passes. Feed the judge a truncated JSON verdict → UNEVALUATED (already merged #3540) — the positive control that a well-formed 'high' still reads 'high'.
prevention.missing_primitive: Ratchet (primitive 3) on the gate estate itself, and contract test (primitive 4) between an acknowledgement and the state it claims to explain.
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — CI seconds; the alarm-threshold fix re-thresholds two existing digest-routed alarms

detection.what: The wrap battery prints the three census counters with their deltas every session and the (e10) gate's staleness rule runs there too — both already-running scripts. For the runtime half (OBS-5's saturating alarm and the canary heartbeat), the observability path-to-A's +1 custom metric (NewInteriorGapCount) and +1–2 alarms is the only rent in this class.
detection.demote_trigger: Retire NewInteriorGapCount and its alarm if 90 days pass with the interior-gap alarm never lit on a second source while a first is unfillable (the condition it exists for never occurs), or once the #2643 absence marker is applied to every DAILY_SOURCE (derived from the registry) so the saturation cannot arise
detection.rent_estimate: ~$0.20/mo (one custom metric series + one or two CloudWatch alarms), within PROPORTIONALITY's monitoring row

root_cause_classes.name: Review cadence as intake — grades carried forward across resets, path-to-A items that never became owned work, and a delta that selects rows by diff instead of by event
root_cause_classes.thesis: The review is the platform's only from-scratch measurement and it is also the intake for most of its backlog (84 of the 297 issues filed since 08-22 carry `review:fullreview-2026-09-05`; 4 other review labels account for 46 more). Its cadence made the 09-05 result inevitable: 8 of 17 lenses were last graded from scratch on 07-28/08-02 and carried forward by name through the 08-09 and 08-16 deltas; the 08-27 delta was held for an instrument rewrite (recorded, correctly), leaving a 20-day hole; delta rows are selected by diff paths, so a reset — which touches no path but rewrites the world — never selects the narrative/CPO/reader/growth rows; and the prior reviews' path-to-A B-class items (a11y-3's 'July step 4', DES-2's 'measure clean first, then extend' with no clock) had no owning issue, so the delta's 'unresolved P1/P2' rule could not see them. The 09-05 baseline then extended all 17 A anchors onto the Day-0 surface on the day it ran — a legitimate raise, but one that makes '13 dropped' partly a measurement of a new bar rather than of decay.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The rubric's delta selection is path-based; `unchanged_lenses` is written honestly but nothing ages it (a grade carried 5 weeks reads the same as one carried 1); path-to-A B items live in a markdown ledger, not in the issue corpus the closure contract governs; the operating calendar's dead-man probes that a file landed, not that a lens was graded within N days.

prevention.what: (1) `full.md` delta row-selection adds an EVENT term: if a reset (a new `CYCLE_GENESES` entry or a `RESET_LOG` line) falls in the range, the reset-touching rows (narrative, CPO, reader, growth, data-architect, qs, aiq, observability) run regardless of diff, and the artifact's `method` records day-of-cycle at run time so a reader can see which reviews have ever observed Day 0–1. (2) A carried-forward grade may not be carried past 28 days — `unchanged_lenses` entries older than that force the row into the next delta (a test over the grades JSON in `scripts/operating_calendar.py`'s probe). (3) Every B-class path-to-A item is filed at Phase 4 as an acceptance box on the class epic (the issue-filer already does class-first filing; make the B items non-optional inputs to it), so the next delta's 'unresolved' rule sees them in the corpus, and the closure contract's `epic-children-open` code owns their disposal.
prevention.where: .claude/skills/review/references/full.md (delta selection + method fields), scripts/operating_calendar.py (probe reads `unchanged_lenses` ages), scripts/review_anchors.py (emit day-of-cycle), .claude/agents/issue-filer.md (B-class path-to-A → epic acceptance boxes, mandatory)
prevention.negative_control: Feed the calendar probe a grades JSON whose `unchanged_lenses` cites a run 35 days old → the fullreview-delta entry reports 'stale carry-forward: <lens>' instead of green; run a delta over a range containing a RESET_LOG line with a diff touching only tests/ → the selected-row list must include narrative/CPO/reader (assert in a rubric-shape test); file a review batch whose path-to-A has a B item with no epic box → issue-filer output lists it as unfiled (never silently dropped).
prevention.missing_primitive: Dead-man (primitive 5) on the grade itself — the calendar has a dead-man on the artifact file, not on the age of each lens's last from-scratch grade; and registry (primitive 1) for B-class remediation items, which lived in prose ledgers outside the issue corpus.
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 in AWS; it does NOT add reviews — it changes which rows a weekly delta selects (the review's token cost is already a standing item and is unchanged)

detection.what: The operating calendar's existing fullreview-delta probe, extended to read each lens's carry-forward age from the newest grades JSON and to print 'lenses not graded from scratch in >28d: [...]' in the boot brief. FREE — the probe already runs at SessionStart and at wrap.
detection.demote_trigger: n/a

forensics.evidence_quality:
Established by measurement in this session (read-only): the direct-push split on main since 08-22 (302/613; 156 bot, 146 session account; 179 code-touching) from `git log`; the absence of any pre-push hook or pytest leg (`.git/hooks/` holds commit-msg + pre-commit only, `deploy/agent_commit.sh` has zero `pytest`, `scripts/install_hooks.sh` names none); `closure_contract.py` DEFAULT_MODE='warn'; the closed-issue audit (289 closed since 08-22: 25 zero-comment, 173 `Shipped:`, ~122 with a live-looking token; 297 filed, 229 closed, median 9.0h, 186/229 <24h) from `gh` reads; the gate census (597 gates, 50 proven, 538 unproven, 49 vacuous-empty, 33 swallowed-exit) from running `scripts/gate_census.py`; the review-cadence facts (`unchanged_lenses` in the 08-09/08-16 deltas, the 08-27 hold in `operating_calendar.py`, review dates vs `CYCLE_GENESES`); the keyword clustering (33/99 findings citing a prior issue in their class string; 39/99 reset/phase-related; 6/7 P1s in the reset window).

Taken from the process verdicts and findings without independent re-measurement: the principal verdict's '26 of 29 red Unit-Test runs were direct pushes' and '35 of 101 new source-scanning guards skipped a positive control' (I measured the push mix, not the red-run attribution); the durations of the dead instruments (49/28/30+/21 days) as stated in INT-1, G-3, OBS-1, CPO-2; the 18:00:44Z sweep timing and the reset gate timings from HANDOVER_LATEST.md and CPO-1/NARR-1.

Inferred, not established: (a) that each finding's introducing commit was a direct push — I did not trace 99 introducing commits to push type, so class 1's membership is by mechanism (the path those changes take), not by per-finding provenance; (b) 'unproven' in the census means no registered mutation proof, not 'cannot fail' — some of the 538 were doubtless proven ad hoc in PR bodies, so the number overstates the vacuous set while the 49+33 flags understate it; (c) the 'live-ish evidence' heuristic over closing comments (http/curl/'live' substring) is crude in both directions; (d) how much of the 13-lens drop is anchor extension vs decay cannot be separated from the artifact — every lens carries an EXTENSION note and I did not re-grade against the old anchors; (e) the ADR-099 'Effort in the denominator favours instance fixes' claim rests on the memory entry and the median 9h close time, not on a scored comparison of instance vs class issues; (f) the cost figures for the two STANDING_RENT items are CloudWatch list-price estimates, not measured. Overlaps between classes are real (a11y-3 sits in three; the reset class and the closure class share NARR-5/G-1) and are left as overlaps rather than forced into one bucket, because the fix for each lives at a different stage.

forensics.lens: SDLC forensics — every finding traced to the workflow stage it entered and what the gate at that stage would have had to see
forensics.the_70_question:
Four mechanisms, each with numbers, and none of them is "the platform suddenly got worse".

(1) BREADTH, NOT A SPIKE. Per-lens yield has been roughly constant: the 08-09 delta found 41 findings across 7 lenses (5.9/lens), the 08-16 delta 27 across 7 (3.9/lens), and 09-05 found 99 confirmed across 17 (5.8/lens). What changed is the denominator. The delta chain re-graded only "lenses touched by the change surface" (7 of 17 each time); the other 10 — cpo, designer, dataviz, qs, a11y, cost, devex, growth (+reader, data-architect from 08-09) — had "grades stand" since 07-28/08-02, i.e. 5 weeks and ~600 main commits per fortnight (git log: 613 commits on main since 08-22) of unreviewed drift. docs/OPERATING_CALENDAR.md:53 predicted this in its own words ("Deltas drift … a slow slide can stay invisible to every individual delta"), and the monthly full (31d+7d grace from 07-16 → due ~08-23) ran on 09-05, ~13 days late. The delta method assumed unchanged code ⇒ unchanged grade; this platform's defects come from scheduled writers, resets and the calendar, not from diffs.

(2) THE GRADED INSTANT WAS THE WORST ONE, AND NO PRIOR RUN HAD SAMPLED IT. Day 0 of a same-week re-anchor, ~10h after the chronicle-approve 18:00Z sweep ran against a tombstoned draft. Seven of 99 findings (CPO-1, NARR-1, NARR-2, R1, G-1, G-2, QS-1) are literally that event and its share/recap/prediction shadows; another eleven (DA-2/6/7/9, CPO-4, AIQ-5, NARR-5, OBS-6, a11y-3, OBS-3, CTO-3) are the same shape — a surface verified at t0 and rewritten by a writer after. restart_verify's 23 checks, ci-cd's post-deploy job (I1/I2/I5 = handler names, layer retired) and the wrap battery (16 gates, zero of which fetch a served URL) all stop at one instant.

(3) STAGE FORENSICS: ~90% ENTERED WHERE NO GATE COULD SEE THEM, NOT WHERE ONE WAS BYPASSED. My assignment of the 99: 26 entered at PR review as guards pinned to one instance/hand-picked scan set (class D), 18 as hand copies of a registry vocabulary or literal restating a derived number (E), 14 as arithmetic in shared builders/stats with no contract test (F) → 58 at implementation with the relevant gate absent or scanning a subset; 18 at operate/reset after a green point-in-time verify (B); 13 at closure — closed on the merge with no first live observation (C); 10 at merge through the ungated direct-push path (A). Only class A (10%) is "a gate existed and the path skipped it". The rest were silent because the platform's gates are METADATA-shaped (main-green reads a rollup; check_alarm_citations matches alarm NAME to an entry; closure_contract checks the SHAPE of the closing comment; wait_pr_green compares check NAMES) while the defects are CONTENT-shaped (served bytes, y-domains, a denied put_item, a pooled base rate).

(4) THE LESSONS EXISTED AS RECALL, NOT ENFORCEMENT. 85 review-discipline memory entries, 403 memory files, and two skills (/prove-it, /new-machinery) that name almost every mechanism above — and `grep -rl 'prove-it|new-machinery'` over .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, .github/, CONVENTIONS.md, CHARTER.md returns only the two skills themselves and /incident. Neither is referenced by /land, /wrap, CI, or the PR template. The PR template (.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) instructs "Targeted `pytest` for what I touched" — the exact behaviour that redded main twice in Session U (HANDOVER_LATEST.md:13). scripts/closure_contract.py is DEFAULT_MODE = "warn" with a 10-clean-wraps/25-merges flip bar. #3477 was closed "Outcome: realized" at 06:17Z on 09-04 and its class recurred (principal-02, ×5 test_plan_literal_reconciliation) the same day. Age signals in the review text: "has never produced" ×5, "has never graded" ×2, "for 49 days" ×3 (INT-1), "since #151" (DES-1), "since 2026-06-24" (CPO-2's dark metric), "since 2026-08-08" (G-3) — several predate delta reviews that held those lenses at A-/B+, and the designer row's prior A- was measured on "7 pages rendered" of an 89-page registry. The review process itself carried the class-D defect: it sampled instances, not the set.

root_cause_classes.name: A. The ungated landing path — direct pushes, the reset pipeline and the wrap commit meet only the format hook
root_cause_classes.thesis: main is protected only against the ~90s fast lane (ADR-148: required = `Collect + deploy-critical + format` + gitleaks; Unit Tests, Lint, docs-ci, v4-gate are `advisory_not_required`), the ADR-148 amendment made the OWNER's user account the ruleset bypass, and ci-cd's `deploy` job needs [reconcile, plan] where plan needs only test-critical — so a red full suite still ships (ADR-117 by design). Everything that lands as a direct push therefore meets ONE gate: .git/hooks/pre-commit, which is black+ruff on staged Python and nothing else; deploy/agent_commit.sh runs no pytest; there is no pre-push hook. In 14 days 146 non-bot direct pushes hit main (83 docs, 38 fix, 19 chore, 2 feat), the reset pipeline's final instruction is literally `git status / commit the regenerated files … from MAIN` (restart_pipeline.py:1184) and its own sweep (restart_verify_gates.py) runs the Docs-CI gate list + `node --test` but zero pytest, so every python reader of deploy/generated/** reds main at every reset (08-31 and 09-04, both verified). The PR template asks for targeted pytest — the behaviour that broke main twice in one night. INCIDENT_LOG's derived pattern block already counts 30 'lane-subset / union-breach main red' rows.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The gates are sound but sit on the PR path; the path most commits use (direct push by the bypass actor) has no test stage between the author's terminal and main, and the deploy chain never depended on the full suite. The two instruments that read main's verdict afterwards (check_main_green.py / check_ci_warnings.py) read the run ROLLUP, which docs-ci's cancel-in-progress and the deploy-group eviction turn to `cancelled` over a real red (DEVEX-1/2, fixed for the reader side by #3530 — the cancel mechanism itself remains). wrap_gates.py hand-lists 4 of Docs-CI's 12 gates (DEVEX-3) although `restart_verify_gates.docs_ci_gate_commands()` already derives the set.

prevention.what: A pre-push hook on the direct-push path: when the upstream is main, run `pytest -m 'premerge and not integration'` (8,813 tests / 155s per tests/conftest.py:164) PLUS the derived set of tests that open deploy/generated/** or the prereg stamp (grep/AST-derived, never hand-listed), refuse the push on red. Same derived doc-gate list for every producer of a main commit (reset sweep, wrap battery, hook) via `docs_ci_gate_commands()`. Replace the PR template line 'Targeted pytest' with the premerge lane. Key docs-ci.yml/v4-gate.yml concurrency on github.sha for push events so a main push never cancels another's verdict.
prevention.where: scripts/install_hooks.sh (new pre-push), deploy/agent_commit.sh (--push mode), deploy/restart_verify_gates.py (python leg), scripts/wrap_gates.py (doc leg derived), .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .github/workflows/docs-ci.yml + v4-gate.yml concurrency blocks, tests/test_claude_hooks.py-style assertion that the hook is installed and names the marker
prevention.negative_control: Plant a failing premerge test on a branch whose upstream is main and `git push` → refused with the test named; a docs-only wrap commit that breaks `sync_doc_metadata --check` → wrap_gates red; a regenerated genesis_preregistration.json that breaks test_plan_literal_reconciliation → restart_pipeline aborts before the commit step (today it exits 0). Positive control: a green tree pushes in ≤3 min.
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard — the gate SET must derive from the workflow YAML for every producer of a main commit (the new-machinery skill's own 'a derived artifact needs its LANE' trap); the reset and wrap are lanes without it.
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 AWS; ~155s of session wall-clock per direct push

detection.what: One leg in the existing weekly drift sentinel (GET-only): count main runs where `test / Unit Tests` = failure AND the head commit is not a PR merge (no `(#N)` suffix, non-bot author); print the number in the Monday report and red the wrap's main-green gate when it is >0 for the week. It is a count over data the sentinel already fetches.
detection.demote_trigger: Four consecutive weekly reports at zero after the pre-push hook lands → fold the leg into the gate census header and stop printing it.
detection.rent_estimate: ~0 CI-minutes marginal

root_cause_classes.name: B. Point-in-time verification of a surface that scheduled writers keep rewriting — the reset/deploy verifies at t0, 104 schedules write at t+N, nothing re-asserts served ⊆ registry-visible
root_cause_classes.thesis: The reset's gate battery (rendered 96/96, semantic 8/8, truth clean at ~16:5xZ), restart_verify's 23 checks, ci-cd's post-deploy job and the visual-qa deploy pass all assert the served surface once. Then 104 `schedule=` definitions in cdk/stacks plus the chronicle 48h sweep, og-image, the recap writer and every coach writer rewrite it. The writers select by status/timestamp (chronicle_approve_lambda: status=draft + 48h..10d age), stamp provenance from a constant (`experiment_stamp()` phase=experiment/cycle=16 before genesis — QS-1, DA-6), or never adopted `tag_record` (DA-7: rows written 32 min AFTER the tagger ran). My count: 160 lambda modules call `.query(`/`.scan(`, 69 of them with no phase helper (`with_phase_filter`/`singleton_visible`/`cycle_read_floor`/PHASE_FILTER) in the file — the #2109 ratchet covers the readers it enumerates, not the set. Acknowledgement layers have the same shape in time: check_alarm_citations matches alarm NAME to an entry and never `citation.added` vs `StateTransitionedTimestamp` (OBS-2, CTO-3); the remediation agent reads the 09-02 drift record as current on 09-04 (OBS-3); the a11y ledger is stale-in-the-good-direction with no consumer of the shrink list (a11y-3); the challenges catalog serves a prior-cycle statistic with no as-of (AIQ-5).
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: Every existing gate has a time axis of zero: restart_verify proves the manifest at reset time and stops; qa_smoke_lambda (nightly, 11 checks) has podcast-parity and permalink-blackhole checks on posts.json but nothing asking 'is every listed post allowed to exist in this cycle'; the #3390 Day-1 runlist has no T+24h re-curl; the wipe tombstones but leaves status=draft so an age-only selector cannot distinguish 'forgot to click' from 'tombstoned'. The writer↔writer (co-owned record) seam has no contract entry type — tests/pair_contract_registry.py enrolls 17 producer→consumer pairs and zero writer↔writer pairs; #3443's fix guarded one instance while the class stayed open. NARR-5/G-1 show the archive step 'fired' and was a silent no-op by dest-key collision (html_files_archived=0, already_archived=29) and its report line was never a gate.

prevention.what: (1) Writer-side derivation guard: an AST set-guard that every put/update on an EXPERIMENT_SCOPED partition routes through tag_record/experiment_stamp gated by should_phase_stamp, and every reader of a scoped partition through the phase filter — shrink-only allowlist of the ~69 current raw callers, dated. (2) A CoOwned writer↔writer entry class in tests/pair_contract_registry.py (replay B after A, assert A's fields survive) enrolling chronicle DATE# (status vs tombstone), habit_scores, engagement_state, RELATIONSHIP#state. (3) The reset flips in-window drafts to status=voided when it tombstones them and restart_verify asserts the sweep's candidate set is EMPTY post-reset plus a data census ('no EXPERIMENT_SCOPED row dated < genesis without phase=pilot', 'no CROSS_PHASE row tombstoned', 'every classify()==EXPERIMENT_SCOPED pk family is in the wipe's covered set'). (4) archive_one keys on (slug, cycle) and any step whose report says moved=0 on a cycle with published content is a red, not a line.
prevention.where: tests/test_phase_filter_ratchet (extend #2109), tests/pair_contract_registry.py (+CoOwned kind), deploy/restart_intelligence_wipe.py, deploy/restart_verify.py (census step), deploy/restart_chronicle_handler.py:248-252, lambdas/content/chronicle_approve_lambda.py::_find_stale_drafts
prevention.negative_control: Fixture: a DATE# draft inside the 48h..10d window with tombstone=True or phase != current must NOT be returned by _find_stale_drafts, and the identical un-tombstoned record MUST be (positive control). Reset dry-run on a tree with one raw `table.query` on a scoped partition and no phase helper → set-guard red naming the file. A planted status=draft row post-wipe → restart_verify census red. Age a week-NN page's mtime past the reset and keep it out of posts.json → the archive assertion reds.
prevention.missing_primitive: Contract test on the writer↔writer seam and the dead-man at the SERVED surface (the charter's primitive 4 was applied producer→consumer only, and primitive 5 was applied to 'did the job run', never to 'is what it wrote still allowed').

detection.what: Nightly served-surface contract inside the existing qa_smoke_lambda run (no new schedule): served /journal/posts.json date-set == DDB visible (phase=experiment, no tombstone) chronicle set; /moments/index.json ⊆ posts.json; every 200 /journal/posts/week-NN/ ∈ posts.json; newest served posts/moments/recap entry date ≥ genesis while day_n ≥ 0; served /api/predictions season rows ⊆ frozen prereg ids; plus a citation-staleness rule in check_alarm_citations (citation.added < StateTransitionedTimestamp → UNCITED). The #3485 dead-man is the first member; make it the family. Add a T+24h re-run of restart_verify's served checks to the Day-1 runlist.
detection.demote_trigger: 90 consecutive nights with zero findings AND the writer-side set-guard proven (mutation evidence in the gate census) → drop the served contract to the weekly visual-qa fire and delete the nightly leg.
detection.rent_estimate: ~5 DDB reads + ~6 HTTPS GETs per night inside a Lambda that already runs: <$0.05/mo; the citation rule is $0 (wrap-time script)

root_cause_classes.name: C. Instruments that cannot fail, closed on the merge — fail-soft paths, mocked transport, thresholds that cannot be reached, and a closure contract that checks the comment's shape rather than a first live observation
root_cause_classes.thesis: A fix or detector ships with green tests whose transport is faked (FakeDdbTable, mocked grader, single-dimension list_metrics fixture), the issue closes on `Fixes #N` or on an `**Outcome:** realized` sentence, and nothing ever asks whether the thing produced its first real output. INT-1: #1480's notion sentinel put_item is denied by IAM on every run since 07-18 (LeadingKeys-scoped to apple_health) and logs 'non-fatal' at ERROR for 49 days; G-3: #2254's `_record_email_send` denied PutItem since 08-08 while /api/status reads 'never sent'; OBS-1: #1956 closed 'Outcome: partial … Post-deploy: a served-context number never alarms' — the check has never once produced its measurement (AccessDenied on a missing key → chronic WARN excluded from WarnCount); CPO-2: 480 commitments, 0 graded, 21 daily runs logging kept=0 broken=0, the only test mocks the grader; DA-1: a float crash AFTER the SES send, ledger row stuck at 'attempting' for 5 days; AIQ-2: both AI judges turn a missing/truncated verdict into 'ok' (5 truncations in 14d); CTO-2/CTO-5: Errors ≥3/hr on a surface with ~8 failing requests a WEEK (copied from slo-mcp-availability) — the #3413 lesson was applied to the client cap but not to the alarm guarding the same surface; OBS-5/OBS-7/COST-01/DEVEX-8: thresholds and waivers sized on a founding-week snapshot with a 'revisit' clause that has no carrier; G-8: a lifecycle with no terminal transition. scripts/closure_contract.py has six requirements, all about the comment's structure and the closing set; none requires evidence of a live observation, and it is DEFAULT_MODE='warn'. #3477 closed 'realized' at 06:17Z 09-04; its class recurred by the afternoon.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The PR gate saw green tests over a fake wire (§9a's 'fixture must be the wire' is a rule in CONVENTIONS, not a test over tests); /land §4 verifies the deployed SYMBOL is present and wired, not that its first live call succeeded; the only alarm on each checker watches AWS/Lambda Errors, which a swallowed exception never increments; chronic=True warns are deliberately excluded from WarnCount (#2378), so 'never produced a value' and 'healthy' share one colour; /prove-it's five questions ('make the must-fail case actually fail', 'print the denominator') are in a skill nothing invokes at close time.

prevention.what: (1) closure_contract gains a seventh requirement `first-live-observation`: any close whose PR touches a fail-soft path (a caught exception that logs and continues), a scheduled instrument, an alarm threshold, or a new DynamoDB/S3/SES verb must carry `**Observed:** <UTC timestamp> — <the instrument's first non-degraded live output>`; closure_sweep emits `no-live-observation`; the flip to `block` is measured per FLIP_BAR, not the calendar. (2) IAM-parity contract generalised from tests/test_site_api_write_scope.py + test_freshness_checker_iam_parity.py: for every role in role_policies*.py, AST-derive the owning module's DDB/S3/SES verbs and pk literals and assert containment (INT-1's notion pk must FAIL today, G-3's PutItem must FAIL today). (3) A 'never-fired' ratchet: any qa-smoke check whose output has been chronic/None for 30 days, any grader whose graded count is 0 with due>0, any alarm whose threshold exceeds its surface's measured median hourly traffic without a dated registry entry — red in tests/, shrink-only allowlist. (4) UNEVALUATED as a named judge outcome with a truncated-JSON must-fail fixture. (5) /land §5 links /prove-it explicitly: 'a green suite over a mocked transport does not satisfy Observed'.
prevention.where: scripts/closure_contract.py + scripts/closure_sweep.py; tests/test_site_api_write_scope.py → tests/test_role_write_scope_parity.py (every LeadingKeys role, every email sender); tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py; tests/reader_truth_qa + visual_ai_qa parse paths; .claude/skills/land/SKILL.md §4-5
prevention.negative_control: Closing comment with `**Outcome:** realized` and no `**Observed:**` line on a PR that adds an `except Exception: log.error(...)` → closure_sweep finding; the notion sentinel pk against the freshness-checker role → parity test RED today (goes green only when the grant or the pk moves); a truncated verdict JSON → judge test FAIL, well-formed → pass; threshold 3 on a Lambda whose synthesized traffic facet says median 1/hr → reachability test red.
prevention.missing_primitive: Dead-man in the ADR-104 sense — 'absence must be louder than failure' was applied to 'did the job run' (heartbeats) but not to 'did the job ever produce the thing it exists to produce'; and the contract primitive on the real wire (IAM) rather than a fake table.

detection.what: A Logs MetricFilter on `level=ERROR` (the monitoring_stack.py:993 pattern) for the operational checkers (freshness-checker, chronicle-email-sender, coach-nudge, qa-smoke) routed to the digest, plus an emitted CommitmentsGraded/CommitmentsDueCheckable pair with one alarm (due>0 ∧ graded==0 for 14d). A swallowed AccessDenied logged 'non-fatal' becomes visible within a day instead of never.
detection.demote_trigger: If the ERROR filter produces 0 datapoints for 90 days across all four functions, collapse to ONE fleet-wide filter on /aws/lambda/life-platform-* and retire the per-function ones; if the commitment grader's dead-man never fires in a full cycle after the writer-side ADR-104 rule lands, fold the count into the existing coach heartbeat census and delete the alarm.
detection.rent_estimate: 4 metric filters (free tier) + 2 alarms ≈ $0.20–0.40/mo; the commitment metric pair ≈ $0.10/mo (the CPO-2 finding's own estimate)

root_cause_classes.name: D. Guard the instance, not the set — the fix for an incident lands on the one specimen and the guard's scan set is a hand-picked subset of the estate, with no positive control
root_cause_classes.thesis: An incident names a failing instance; the session fixes that instance and writes a guard pinned to it — one file (OBS-4: test_composite_alarm_lookup_3390 covers restart_verify.py while agent.py:557, check_alarm_citations.py:495/:521, site_api_status.py:95 and drift_sentinel.py:717 still omit AlarmTypes), one page set (DES-2: the 11px floor measured on 3 of 89 pages; DES-1: the mobile scroll position never asserted in either harness), one sheet class (DES-4: the raw-hex gate sweeps stylesheets, not JS template strings), one cohort (CTO-5: the DLQ contract on the ingestion cohort, not on Event-invoked targets), one source (INT-3: #2643's absence marker on eightsleep only; DAILY_SOURCES hand-typed and outside test_source_enumeration_drift), one relation of three (AIQ-1: #3050 pins hazard-before-privacy only), one route (SEC-2: the origin check test names /api/foo, not the handler's early-return set), one directory (SEC-1: pii_surface_guard scans site/ and names generated/ as its own gap in its docstring; R2: cast guard's PROMPT_LITERAL_DIRS excludes deploy/ and config/), one id list (DA-2: assert_registry_coverage derives from OPERATIONAL_COACH_IDS, so COACH#nudge_ledger rows survived three resets), five declared names (OBS-8: the log-retention leg), one package (principal-08: the dead-def guard on lambdas/intelligence only). The a11y ledger accepts serious entries indefinitely because nothing requires an `issue` field (a11y-6) and the opacity-recede grammar was fixed three times as instances (a11y-1), the light-override class three times (a11y-2). My grep: 163 test files ast.parse/ast.walk first-party source; 69 carry any positive-control/must-fail/mutation wording; ~94 (58%) do not — consistent with the principal row's '35 of 101 new source-scanning guards skipped it'.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The guard passed its own review because it caught its own incident; nobody asked 'what else is a member of this set?' — the #2844 conformance guard keys on four registry vocabularies (sources, personas, lambda names, alarm names) and does not cover a test's own hand-typed path/id/page lists; qa_manifest.py is THE page registry per the charter but TEXT_FLOOR_PAGES, the scroll assertion and the sitemap generator do not derive from it (G-7 enumerates files); CONVENTIONS §9 registers 87 defect-class→gate rows but registering a gate does not require it to enumerate from a registry or to carry a must-fail case — 'prove it can fail (mutation evidence)' is a sentence in the charter's paved road for gates, and the gate census records only 6 proven proofs by hand (gate_census.py:26).

prevention.what: Two structural tests over tests/ itself: (1) POSITIVE-CONTROL RULE — any tests/test_*.py that ast.parse()s, ast.walk()s or regex-scans first-party source must contain a synthetic must-fail case for the same helper (marker `@pytest.mark.positive_control` or a `_must_fail` sibling), with the ~94 current files as a dated shrink-only allowlist; (2) SCAN-SET RULE — a guard's scan set (paths, ids, pages, alarm names, roles) must be derived from a named registry (qa_manifest, source_registry, persona_registry, role_policies*, the synthesized CDK template, the workflow YAML) — extend tests/test_conformance_guard_2844.py's vocabulary keys to include hand-typed scan lists inside tests/ and deploy/. Plus the review question in the PR template and /land: 'name the SET this guard enumerates and the registry it derives from'. Concrete first members: AlarmTypes required on every describe_alarms/describe_alarm_history with StateValue=; DLQ/OnFailure on every Event-invoked/SNS-subscribed target from the synthesized template; hex/matchMedia sweep over site/assets/js/*.js; scrollY==0 + hero-in-viewport at 390 over qa_manifest; text floor over qa_manifest tier 1–2; cast-name scan over deploy/**/*.py + config/*.json; a11y serious/critical entries require `issue`.
prevention.where: tests/test_guard_positive_controls.py (new, structural), tests/test_conformance_guard_2844.py + tests/conformance_residue.py (vocabularies extended), scripts/check_css_tokens.py, tests/visual_qa.py + tests/pr_render_gate.py (registry-derived page sets), tests/test_composite_alarm_lookup_3390.py (walk the tree), tests/test_a11y_audit.py (#2956 twin), .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
prevention.negative_control: Add a new tests/test_x.py that ast.walks lambdas/ with no must-fail case → the positive-control rule reds naming the file; add a fifth describe_alarms(StateValue=…) call without AlarmTypes anywhere in lambdas/ scripts/ deploy/ remediation/ → red; plant `style="--coach:#abcdef"` in a JS template → hex gate finding; add a page to qa_manifest that scrolls on load at 390 → render gate red; add a serious axe entry with no `issue` → a11y audit red. Positive control: the existing allowlisted files stay green until touched (editing one re-reds it by construction, the #2844 mechanic).
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard applied to the guard itself — 'guard the SET, not the instance' is the charter's own exemplar sentence (CHARTER.md:26) and the most-repeated memory lesson (10+ recurrences); it has never been enforced over tests/.

detection.what: Make the gate census's `unproven` count a shrink-only ratchet in tests/ (it already computes proven/unproven per gate, #2578) and print the SET-derivation status per gate next to it; the /wrap gate battery reads the two numbers and reds when either grew. No new job.
detection.demote_trigger: When unproven reaches 0 and stays there for two monthly full reviews, retire the ratchet into the census header.

root_cause_classes.name: E. A second hand copy of a registry vocabulary or a literal that restates a derived number on a reader-bound surface (templates, JSON config, JS strings, prose, email copy) — outside the derivation net
root_cause_classes.thesis: The derivation-guard primitive is real for Python consumers of four vocabularies (#2844) and for doc facts keyed on specific phrases (#2003, check_doc_facts / check_memory_body_facts), but reader-bound text lives on surfaces the net does not reach: the brief's source inventory collapses paused/lag facets to a binary so coaches invent a sync story (AIQ-4); /api/explain builds its own phase line beside the #1086 shared block (AIQ-6); data_phase is a constant 'established' (AIQ-8); the onboarding email re-derives 'Week N' ignoring the manifest's `label` (CPO-5); the confirmation email hand-types '19 sources' against 20 (curated) and 22 (registry) with no documented semantic for the difference (G-6); /subscribe/ promises one Wednesday email while three CDK schedules + the 48h sweep deliver up to three, none on Wednesday (G-4); the sender identity has two homes, one unsendable (G-9); og-glucose is a hard-coded 'Real CGM data. Updated daily.' over a null feed (G-5); the collagen copy narrates a 117-lb journey against a 140-lb hero (R5); /api/receipts drops `projected_all_classes` that the SSM payload already carries (COST-02), pins a false disclaimer whose CONDITION a test never checks (COST-03), triple-counts a dimension set (COST-04); ARCHITECTURE.md states a 30-min canary cadence that is rate(4h) and 'all async → DLQ' (CTO-4); the registry's own prose misstates its alarm's route (INT-4); MEMORY.md says genesis 09-04 against constants 09-05 and both fact gates are phrase-keyed ('always use <date>', 'currently <date>') so a wrong genesis in other words is invisible (DEVEX-5); CLAUDE.md points at a deploy.md that does not exist inside a code fence the link gate skips (DEVEX-7); tests hand-type '1,500' two lines after deriving it from GOALS and pin GENESIS_ISO literally so every reset edits the test (principal-03); a coverage header carries three eras of numbers (principal-07); /data/ and /protocols/ carry a 33-day-old 'as of' because their proof builder is not in the deploy path's list (NARR-4).
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: check_doc_facts and the conformance guard match phrases or Python AST; email templates, site copy, config JSON, JS template strings, YAML comments and fenced blocks are not swept; a test that asserts a disclaimer asserts its wording, not the condition it claims (COST-03); 'curated' vs 'registry' counts have no recorded semantic so no rule can pick one; the every-phrase-matched member of the #2959/#3003/#3199 family has failed in the field and DEVEX-5 is the fifth specimen.

prevention.what: Extend the derivation net to reader-bound surfaces, structurally not by phrase: (1) a served-string numeric rule — any `n=<int>`, `<int> sources`, `<int>-lb`, week/day/cycle label or date in a served payload or template must equal a numeric field in the same payload or a registry read (the DV-1 'n=2' rule generalised); (2) a genesis/cycle token rule in check_doc_facts + check_memory_body_facts scoped to INCLUDE MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md prose: `genesis <date>` / `cycle <N> (LIVE|CURRENT)` must equal constants unless the line is a dated past-tense history row; (3) a sender-registry contract: subscriber-facing send count/weekday derived from email_stack schedules + CHRONICLE_AUTOPUBLISH_HOURS must equal the /subscribe/ and confirmation copy literals; (4) 'a test that asserts a disclaimer must assert its CONDITION' as a structural rule (grep tests for asserted prose containing 'no'/'cannot'/'carries no' and require a sibling assertion on the condition); (5) inventory/phase/data_phase lines derived from source_registry facets and build_experiment_phase_context with a derivation test per registry facet; (6) doc-links resolver taught `see <path>.md` inside fences.
prevention.where: scripts/check_doc_facts.py (rule family), scripts/check_memory_body_facts.py, tests/test_platform_stats_truth.py (email template enrolled), tests/test_receipts_endpoint.py + tests/api_schemas/api_receipts.json, lambdas/coach/coach_brief_input_gate (build_inventory derivation test), lambdas/web/site_api_explain (day_ctx from shared block), scripts/check_doc_links.py, deploy/sync_site_to_s3.sh builder list + restart_verify baked-proof check
prevention.negative_control: Hand-type '19 sources' in email_subscriber_lambda.py while len(SOURCE_REGISTRY)=22 → red naming the line; write 'genesis 2026-09-04' in MEMORY.md against constants 09-05 → check_memory_body_facts red (mutation test in the PR); leave 'n=2' beside len(priors)=15 in site_api_rollups → red; a pre-start date through /api/explain's context must contain 'PRE-START' and never 'restarted'; age a proof stamp on /data/ past 7 days → deploy assertion red. Positive controls: derived copy passes unchanged across a reset.
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard on non-Python surfaces (the registry primitive exists; the guard that consumers derive stops at the .py boundary).

detection.what: Reuse the daily standalone visual-qa fire's reader-truth judge as the only rent: add the pre-start temporal rule and the paused-source rule as deterministic freshness-class members registered in tests/grounding_wiring.py so they are in the census (no LLM needed for those two); the existing judge remains the catch-all with #3480's auto-file. No new schedule.
detection.demote_trigger: n/a — no new standing machinery; if the deterministic rules produce zero findings across two full cycles and the judge never files their class, fold them into the freshness rule's docstring and delete the members.
detection.rent_estimate: 0 (rides the existing $0.193/run reader-truth fire)

root_cause_classes.name: F. Arithmetic no gate can see — shared chart builders and the statistics core ship with no contract test, and ADR-105 ('uncertainty + n on every claim') is prose rather than an emission contract
root_cause_classes.thesis: The two QA layers that touch charts and numbers are a render sweep (Playwright: overflow, reveals, tap targets) and a prose judge (Bedrock: does the sentence match the fact set). Neither can see a goal entering a y-domain (DV-2: slope flattened ~30x, two doors print opposite verdicts on the same 2.25 lb), two series index-positioned to the same width (DV-3), a stacked bar whose denominator excludes bone next to the scan's own figure (DV-6), a 3.2 lb datum clamped on a 0–3 scale with an aria that asserts the scale (DV-7), a placeholder 50.0 plotted as a vertex (DV-8 — class D), a served 47% odds where every 'survivor' is a censored 1–7 day cycle and 'n=2' sits beside 'over 15 cycles' (DV-1/R3), a pooled Brier skill manufactured by one pooled base rate across strata with 0.216 and 0.788 (QS-3), a one-day level forecast graded as a two-week up-trend because 'recover' substring-matches 'recovery' (QS-4), magic min_effect literals inside a 'grounded' pre-registration whose confirmation_criteria project to null (QS-5), a step count invisible to the numeric-claim regex because it carries no unit token (R4: `_NUMERIC_CLAIM_RE` at intelligence_common.py:655 matches mg/dL|bpm|ms|lbs|kcal|g|% only), a temporal-direction claim about an allowed date (AIQ-3), and absence-as-zero at the phase boundary because the zeroed payload omits the engine's own coverage_hold flag so every consumer's 'held' branch is unreachable (DV-4/DV-5/R8). Only tests/test_constellation_edge_cpts_1215.py imports charts.js at all.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: No contract primitive was ever attached to the shared builders (charts.js) or the stats core (stats_core.py:822 pooled reference, calibration_core.py:259 n-weighted gap) — the pair registry enrolls DDB/S3 wires, not function contracts; the grounding gate's fact universe is unit-bearing numbers and dated facts, so unitless numbers, temporal direction and pooled labels pass; ADR-105 has no executable form (no test that a served statistic carries n/method/CI fields that agree with its prose); the pre-start contract sweep exists (tests/test_pre_start_contract_sweep.py) but did not own absence-as-zero on genesis-clamped windows, so every reset re-mints them.

prevention.what: (1) A Node-executed contract test for charts.js in the Unit Tests job (precedent tests/test_cockpit_scope_history_2672.py shells to node): y-domain identical with/without `goal`; equal-date points share x in dualLineChart (parse the path d-strings); not_instrumented axes omitted; no marker beyond its own scale; exactly one body-fat % equal to body_fat_pct; chStatHtml never emits '0/100' for a held pillar. (2) ADR-105 as an emission contract: every served statistic object carries {n, method, ci|uncertainty} and a test asserts the prose n == the numeric n and the method string names censoring treatment; a two-strata prove-red fixture in test_calibration_core_parity (0.5/22% and 0.8/79% must never read 'well-calibrated'); an all-censored 1–7 day fixture must not raise p30 above the Laplace prior; an emission-time claim-shape classifier with a prove-red test that 'X will be approximately N on <date>' cannot receive type=directional; min_effect derived from trailing personal SD written into the frozen artifact with {metric, sd, n, window}. (3) `_zeroed_pre_experiment` emits coverage_hold:true per pillar and the pre-start contract sweep gains the post-reset-morning fixture and the genesis-clamped-window rule (days=[] not zeros). (4) Grounding: numeric claims without unit tokens (step counts, day counts) join the fact-set check and plan_facts from the frozen prereg join the universe.
prevention.where: tests/test_charts_contract.py (new, node), tests/test_calibration_core_parity.py, tests/test_survival_rollup.py (site_api_rollups.survival), lambdas/experiment/build_predictions (claim-shape classifier + #3046's fixture), lambdas/experiment/build_hypotheses, lambdas/web/site_api_character::_zeroed_pre_experiment, tests/test_pre_start_contract_sweep.py, lambdas/intelligence/intelligence_common.py:655 + position_summary grounding, tests/grounding_wiring.py (temporal rule registered)
prevention.negative_control: Feed lineChart a series with goal=185 far outside the data → the y-domain must equal the no-goal domain or the test fails against today's implementation (it will); two series of unequal length sharing dates → per-date x must match within 0.1px (fails today); all-censored priors → p30 ≤ (reached+1)/(n+2) (fails today at 47%); two unskilled strata → pooled 'skilled' must be None/False (fails today); a claim 'approximately 53.5% on September 5th' → type != directional (fails today); the live Day-0 sentence 'since the September 5th reset' with gen_date < genesis → finding (positive control: 'the reset lands tomorrow' → none).
prevention.missing_primitive: Contract test — on function contracts (a shared builder, a statistic) rather than only on stored wires; ADR-105 has no executable owner.
prevention.rent_estimate: $0; ~10s node in the Unit Tests job

detection.what: None new. The reader-truth judge's daily fire remains the catch-all for prose; the contract tests are the detector because arithmetic defects are deterministic and do not need a scheduled probe — a scheduled check for a pure function would be rent for nothing.
detection.demote_trigger: n/a — if a builder is deleted, its contract test goes with it (the census counts the pair).

forensics.evidence_quality:
ESTABLISHED FROM THE REPO/GH (read-only): the direct-push composition (git log origin/main since 08-22: 613 commits, 302 with no `(#N)` suffix, 146 non-bot; 38 `fix(` direct pushes, 28 of which touch lambdas/deploy/scripts/cdk/tests/site); the pre-commit hook is black+ruff only, agent_commit.sh runs no pytest, no pre-push hook exists; ci-cd's deploy needs [reconcile, plan] and plan needs test-critical only (ADR-117/148 confirmed in DECISIONS.md); restart_verify_gates.py runs docs-ci gates + node --test and zero pytest; wrap_gates.py's 16 gates fetch no served URL; qa_smoke_lambda has 11 `check_` functions and none is a served-vs-registry chronicle contract; closure_contract.py has six structural requirements, DEFAULT_MODE='warn', no live-observation requirement; #1956's closing comment is 'Outcome: partial … Post-deploy: a served-context number never alarms' and #1480 has no closing comment; #3477 closed 'realized' 09-04 06:17Z and its class recurred that day (principal-02); /prove-it and /new-machinery are referenced only by themselves and /incident; the PR template says 'Targeted pytest'; pair_contract_registry has 17 register() calls, all producer→consumer; the delta reviews graded 7 of 17 lenses with 'grades stand' for the rest (grades JSON), 27 and 41 findings respectively; the calendar's fullreview-full cadence is 31d+7d and its own text names the delta-drift mechanism; 104 `schedule=` literals in cdk/stacks; 160 lambda modules call .query/.scan, 69 without a phase helper in-file (a file-level grep — some are legitimately CROSS_PHASE, so this is an upper bound on the exposure, not a defect count); 163 test files ast.parse/ast.walk source and 69 carry positive-control/must-fail/mutation wording (a wording heuristic, not the gate census's proven count, which records 6 proofs).

INFERRED / NOT INDEPENDENTLY RE-VERIFIED: the '26 of 29 red Unit-Test runs were direct pushes' figure is accepted from the adversarially verified principal-01 finding — I did not re-query the Actions API per run; the per-finding stage assignment is my judgement and a finding often spans two stages (I chose the earliest stage at which a FREE gate could have refused it, so class D absorbs several that a later stage would also own, e.g. DV-8, NARR-3); the class boundaries B/E overlap on AIQ-5 and NARR-4 (assigned to B and E respectively by their trigger); the per-lens yield comparison treats the delta files' `findings` arrays (which include 'adjusted' items) as comparable to 09-05's confirmed count; the age-of-defect sample is a grep over phrases in the review text, not a per-finding birth-date ledger; rent figures are list-price order-of-magnitude (alarm $0.10/mo, metric filters free-tier, qa_smoke marginal reads) and were not priced against the live bill; I did not verify that the '35 of 101 new source-scanning guards' number and my 94/163 heuristic measure the same population. I ran no test suite, no gate, and made no gh/AWS writes; the only script executed was scripts/operating_calendar.py --check (read-only, printed 'matches the registry').

forensics.lens: Test oracles and verification — guards that cannot fail, guards that measure a copy of the claim, and the authoring process that keeps producing them
forensics.the_70_question: From this lens the review found 70 because it is the only instrument in the estate that runs the must-fail question against the estate instead of against a diff. My classification of the 99 confirmed findings: 37 are defects IN an instrument (an alarm, gate, sweep, ratchet, ledger, judge or test that cannot fail or measures the wrong thing — CTO-2, CTO-3, principal-02/06/07, AIQ-1/2, CPO-2, DES-2/4, NARR-4/5, a11y-3/6, OBS-1..8, COST-01, DA-2, INT-2, DEVEX-1..6/8, G-1), 15 are product defects that sat behind a guard structurally blind to them (CPO-1, QS-1, SEC-1/2, R1/R2/R4, COST-03/04, INT-1/3, G-3, DV-8, a11y-1/2), and 47 had no guard at all. So 52 of 99 implicate a guard — consistent with the /prove-it skill's own line that ~80% of recent closed issues were instrument defects. Nothing on the platform can find an instrument-that-cannot-fail except an adversary asking "what would make this red" against LIVE state: PR checks execute the guard (green by construction), `scripts/gate_census.py` is syntactic and exits 0 (597 gates, 50 proven, 538 unproven — measured today), `closure_sweep.py` checks the comment's shape, `check_alarm_citations.py` checks a citation EXISTS. The review ran finding-verifier over 17 lenses, set-wise, with read-only AWS/HTTP reproduction, on Day 0 of a reset — the one day every pre-start/phase/tombstone branch is exercised at once (which is also why the reset↔writer cluster, CPO-1/NARR-1/R1/G-1/QS-1/DA-7, all surfaced together). Why the guards were born unable to fail: a guard is authored by an agent session closing an issue, under a PR template whose test box reads "Targeted pytest for what I touched passes locally" (the reflex the 09-04 handover names for breaking main twice), landed at p50 61 minutes open→merge (n=100), with no code-review workflow and one required check, and closed by the same session grading its own Outcome sentence — the instrument agreeing with itself, one level up. 465 guard files entered in 30 days (461 via PR) at that cadence. The one structural entry bar, #2578/#3000, was scoped by owner decision #3329 as an aggregate ratchet (BASELINE_UNPROVEN_GATES=541 vs 538 live): legitimate on cost, but it means "prove one, mint one" — a new gate enters unproven whenever a proof elsewhere made room, and the review's own principal-05 was downgraded to PLAUSIBLE precisely because that ratchet exists. Why memory does not stop it: the /incident skill states it — a memory file is read when recalled, a skill when invoked, and only a gate runs on the path to main; the memory index itself records "Guard the SET — 10+ recurrences" (the count is a symptom of the medium) and carried a wrong genesis date invisible to its own phrase-keyed guard (DEVEX-5). The 84 issues are the backlog of a proof programme the owner declined in aggregate; the fix is not to run the programme retroactively but to close the entrance: no NEW guard, waiver, mirror, or fail-soft path enters without its own must-fail case, derived comparand, set denominator, and first-output evidence — all of which are FREE tests on lanes that already run.

root_cause_classes.name: Born unproven — a guard enters main with no synthetic must-fail case, because the entry bar is an aggregate ceiling with headroom
root_cause_classes.thesis: A session closing an issue writes the check and a test that exercises the healthy path (or the path the author imagined), the PR template asks only for targeted tests, the premerge lane runs the guard green by construction, and the only structural bar — tests/test_gate_census_lane_3000.py — ceilings the AGGREGATE unproven count at 541 while 538 are live, so every proof written elsewhere buys a new unproven entrant. The census exits 0 by design and records proofs in a hand-typed PROVEN_CAN_FAIL list (50 of 597). Result: tests/test_composite_alarm_lookup_3390.py was written in the same session that discovered the class it guards and carries no mutant; a judge's no-verdict path reads as 'ok'; a reset archive step is a silent no-op by dest-key collision; a read-only contract is asserted by the absence of the string '--apply'; a grounding regex that cannot see unit-less numbers was never fed one.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: /prove-it is a user-invoked skill, not a gate; the PR template's checkbox is 'Targeted pytest ... passes' with no line about a must-fail case; gate_census is an instrument (exit 0) and its proof list is hand-typed; #3000's ratchet is on the aggregate, so a single new unproven gate is invisible while the total sits under 541 (3 of headroom today); the closure contract grades the Outcome sentence, not the guard's red. Owner decision #3329 ('a ratchet, not a proof programme') was read as licensing unproven entrants rather than only declining a retroactive programme.

prevention.what: A premerge structural test (tests/test_guard_entry_control.py): every tests/test_*.py or tests/js/*.test.mjs that scans first-party source or asserts a live/AWS/S3 shape (AST-detected: ast.parse/ast.walk/git ls-files/os.walk/rglob/boto3 client on repo paths) must contain at least one test whose body builds a synthetic input (tmp_path/dedent/tempfile/mutant literal) and asserts the guard's failure branch (pytest.raises/SystemExit/assert not ok). Pre-existing offenders go into a dated shrink-only ledger tests/guard_control_residue.py. Second half: change test_gate_census_lane_3000's rule from 'aggregate <= 541' to 'no gate id new since the committed baseline carries unproven' — the entrant ratchet #2578 box 4 actually described, leaving the 538 alone (honours #3329). PR template: replace 'Targeted pytest passes' with 'If this PR adds or changes a gate/check/alarm/sweep: the must-fail case is at <file::test> and the full premerge lane ran'.
prevention.where: tests/conftest.py _PREMERGE_EXTRA_FILES (new file enrolled there so it runs in pr-checks.yml's required fast-lane); tests/test_gate_census_lane_3000.py check_unproven_ceiling; .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md checklist; CONVENTIONS.md §9a gains the sentence as rule
prevention.negative_control: Plant tests/test_probe_no_control.py that os.walk()s lambdas/ and asserts only the healthy path → the new test reds; delete the probe → green. For the ratchet half: extend test_check_function_reds_on_a_synthetic_unverified_addition so that ONE new unproven id reds even when the aggregate is under the ceiling (today that case passes — that is the vacuous control).
prevention.missing_primitive: Ratchet — applied per entrant, not per aggregate; and the contract test's negative half at birth
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — one AST test in a lane that already runs; census derivation measured at 7.8s

root_cause_classes.name: Self-referential oracle — the guard's comparand is a copy of the claim (a mock of the thing under test, a threshold copied from a comment or another surface, a hand-typed mirror of a workflow, a test that pins the prose, a writer's own stamp read as provenance)
root_cause_classes.thesis: The author of a guard also supplies its expected value, and under time pressure the cheapest expected value is a copy: the freshness checker's test used a FakeDdbTable so a denied put_item was unreachable for 49 days; the chronicle sender's write is covered by a test with a mocked table while the role lacks PutItem; the commitment grader's only test mocks the evaluator; site-api-ai-errors' >=3/hr was copied from slo-mcp-availability onto a surface seeing ~8 requests a week; wait_pr_green's expected-check map restates v4-gate.yml's path globs as regexes that drifted; sentinel_cadence expects Mon/Wed/Fri while the workflow's shell guard runs Monday only; test_cost_governor.py hard-codes the stale 288 baseline as 'real'; test_receipts_endpoint pins a disclaimer sentence that was never true; the countdown sweep accepts a row's own cycle stamp as provenance; the memory-facts guard matches the phrase 'always use <date>'. Mutation-provable is not the same as true — the fixture is not the wire (§9a) and the platform has recorded this and re-shipped it.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: §9a is prose plus one worked example; the gate census flags risk shapes syntactically but has no 'comparand is a literal/mock of the subject' family; test_freshness_checker_iam_parity exists for ONE checker and nothing requires the pattern for a new DDB verb; #3474 derived one threshold from a distribution but no test asks every Errors alarm where its number came from; the phrase-keyed-suppressor lesson (#2959/#3003/#3199) is in memory and in the incident skill, not in a check over new guards.

prevention.what: Three derivation guards over the guards themselves, all in the premerge lane: (a) mock-of-subject detector — a test module that patches/mocks the same symbol it asserts on (AST: patch('<mod>.<fn>') where <fn> is the callee under the assertion) is a finding unless allowlisted with a dated reason; (b) IAM-parity for every Lambda: AST-extract dynamodb verbs per module and assert ⊆ the role's actions in cdk/stacks/role_policies*.py (the test_freshness_checker_iam_parity pattern applied to the set — the G-3/INT-1 proposal, already in their filings; the class rule is that the parity test is REQUIRED, enforced by a test that every module calling put_item/update_item is enrolled); (c) comparand-must-derive: alarm thresholds in CDK carry a parseable derivation token (metric, stat, window, date) or a dated exemption, checked by the CTO's tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py; any local mirror of a workflow (expected checks, cadences, gate lists) must parse the YAML (PyYAML+fnmatch) — the DEVEX mirror-derivation contract family, one parity test per mirror, enrolled by a census of `.github/workflows` readers. Add to /new-machinery question 4: 'where does the expected value come from — show the derivation or the captured envelope'.
prevention.where: tests/test_guard_comparand_derivation.py (new, _PREMERGE_EXTRA_FILES); tests/test_lambda_iam_parity_set.py generalising tests/test_freshness_checker_iam_parity.py; tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py; tests/test_wait_pr_green.py parity case; .claude/skills/new-machinery/SKILL.md §4
prevention.negative_control: Plant a test that patches lambdas.operational.freshness_checker.put_sentinel and asserts on put_sentinel → detector reds; add a put_item to a module whose role lacks PutItem (the live INT-1 case, still reproducible until #3560-2's class leg lands) → parity reds; mutate one glob in v4-gate.yml → wait_pr_green parity reds; set an Errors alarm threshold to 3 on a Lambda with no derivation token → reachability reds.
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard — applied to the test's own comparand, and the contract test on the real wire shape (charter rule 3) for IAM verb ↔ role
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — AST sweeps in the existing lane; role_policies are read by AST, no aws_cdk import

root_cause_classes.name: Instance-scoped guard — the fix lands on the specimen that broke and the set is enumerated by hand, so the class stays open with a green guard on one member
root_cause_classes.thesis: An issue is filed naming the file that broke, the acceptance boxes name that file, the session fixes it with a targeted test, and the closure verdict grades an Outcome sentence scoped to the instance. The set — every describe_alarms caller, every daily source, every opacity-dimmed selector, every raw-hex surface, every reader-input write site, every route above the trust boundary, every Event-invoked Lambda, every pk family the taxonomy classifies — is never derived. The platform recorded 'Guard the SET, not the instance — 10+ recurrences' and re-shipped it in at least twenty of these findings; #2643's class fix landed on eightsleep only (#2877), #3390's guard pinned restart_verify.py while four other callers stayed blind, a11y contrast was fixed as an instance three times.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The class-first rule (CONVENTIONS §10) governs FILING, not fixing or closing; the closure contract has no rule about the denominator a guard enumerates; #2844's conformance guard sweeps lambdas/mcp/cdk over four vocabularies (sources, personas, lambda names, alarm names) and never sees a hand-typed DAILY_SOURCES in a checker, COACH_PARTITIONS in the wipe, PROMPT_LITERAL_DIRS in a cast guard, or a five-name list in a sentinel leg; the census reports 'unproven', not 'enumerates from a hand list'.

prevention.what: (1) Closure-contract rule 7 `set-named`: on any issue whose title/class names a set (every/all/each/the set of), the `**Shipped:**` line must state `denominator: <N> <members> derived by <AST|registry|census>` or `instance-only — set carrier #N` (which is a partial, so the issue stays open) — detector in scripts/closure_sweep.py, advisory→block on the existing flip bar. (2) issue-filer contract: for any guard, acceptance box 1 is the derived set with n printed. (3) Extend tests/test_conformance_guard_2844.py's _REGISTRY_ROOTS to tests/, scripts/, deploy/ for hand-typed lists of registry vocabulary, every pre-existing hit into the dated shrink-only tests/conformance_residue.py (36 entries today).
prevention.where: scripts/closure_contract.py + scripts/closure_sweep.py; .claude/agents/issue-filer.md; tests/test_conformance_guard_2844.py + tests/conformance_residue.py; .claude/skills/land/SKILL.md §5
prevention.negative_control: A synthetic closing comment 'fixed for eightsleep' on an issue titled 'every daily source …' with no denominator line → closure_sweep finding; plant `DAILY_SOURCES = ["whoop", "eightsleep"]` in a tests/ or deploy/ file → conformance guard reds; the positive control is the derived form (`[s for s in SOURCE_REGISTRY if …]`) passing.
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard — the SET enumerated from source (charter rule 1), reaching tests/scripts/deploy, not only lambdas/mcp/cdk
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — AST sweeps in the premerge lane; closure sweep already runs at wrap (e8)

root_cause_classes.name: Subset-of-the-gate on the landing path — a local stand-in runs part of the real gate, the direct-push path runs none, and verification is point-in-time while scheduled writers run later
root_cause_classes.thesis: The reset pipeline, wrap commits and fix commits push straight to main; a direct push meets black+ruff (the pre-commit hook) and nothing else — deploy/agent_commit.sh has zero pytest references, the ruleset's only bypass actor is the owner account with bypass 'always'. Each local stand-in for CI hand-lists a subset: restart_verify_gates ran Docs-CI's python gates and node --test with zero pytest (the #3477 class, python leg — 13 tests red on 08-31, 5 runs red on 09-04); wrap_gates.py runs 4 of Docs CI's 12 gates; check_main_green read the run rollup and discarded two real coverage-gate failures as 'cancelled'; docs-ci's cancel-in-progress on main erased 17 of 40 verdicts. And restart_verify proves the served surface at reset time and stops, while the 18:00Z chronicle sweep, the 19:30Z og-image run and the daily grader all write afterwards — so the reset's green was true for ninety minutes. 26 of 29 red Unit-Test runs on main in 14 days were direct pushes.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: The stand-ins are hand-listed mirrors (class 2's shape, at the landing path): docs_ci_gate_commands() existed in restart_verify_gates and was simply not imported by wrap_gates.py; #3477 closed 'realized' on an Outcome sentence scoped to 'will not red Docs CI' with the JS-fixture box unchecked; the ADR-148 ruleset cannot gate a bypass actor; nothing asserts that a script which pushes to main ran the derived stand-in first; the #3390 Day-1 runlist had no re-curl after the first writer window. Instance fixes are already merged (#3530 rollups read from jobs; #3529/31/34 mirrors derive from docs-ci.yml; #3485 nightly manifest dead-man) — the class rule that stops the NEXT stand-in from being a subset is not.

prevention.what: (1) One derived function per CI workflow (the existing restart_verify_gates.docs_ci_gate_commands() generalised to ci_gate_commands(workflow)) that every stand-in imports, with a parity test asserting each stand-in's argv set ⊇ the set parsed from the YAML — and a test that enumerates every stand-in (any module under scripts/ or deploy/ that names a workflow job or calls `git push`) so a new one is enrolled or red. (2) A pre-push hook installed by scripts/install_hooks.sh that runs `pytest -m 'premerge and not integration'` plus the derived artifact-reader set (tests that open deploy/generated/**) whenever the upstream is main; a test asserts the hook is installed and names the marker (the tests/test_claude_hooks.py shape). (3) restart_verify gains a time dimension: the #3390 runlist's re-verify after the first scheduled writer window is a script step, not a checklist line, asserting served /journal/posts.json ⊆ visible DDB chronicle set (the #3485 dead-man's query, run once more at T+2h).
prevention.where: deploy/restart_verify_gates.py (ci_gate_commands), scripts/wrap_gates.py, deploy/wait_pr_green.sh, scripts/check_main_green.py (import the derived set); scripts/install_hooks.sh + .git/hooks/pre-push; tests/test_restart_verify_gates_3477.py (stand-in enumeration + superset parity); deploy/restart_verify.py
prevention.negative_control: Add a `python3 scripts/new_gate.py` step to docs-ci.yml without touching any stand-in → every parity test reds; add a script under deploy/ that calls `git push` without importing the stand-in → the enumeration test reds; the two 09-04 CI runs (cancelled rollup over a failed Unit Tests job) are the must-fail fixtures for check_main_green (already landed by #3530 — keep them as the regression pair).
prevention.missing_primitive: Derivation guard (stand-ins derive from the workflow) plus a ratchet on ungated push sites
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — ~155s of local CPU per direct push (measured premerge lane), CI minutes are free on a public repo

root_cause_classes.name: A waiver outlives its condition — citations, exemptions, chronic warns and debt baselines are written once to make a red go green, then checked for existence and date, never re-derived against the condition they claim
root_cause_classes.thesis: Every acknowledgement layer on the platform is a ledger entry with a date and a length check: docs/alarm_citations.json is matched by alarm NAME (qa-smoke-failures stayed cited 'CURED and PROVEN LIVE' while lit for a new cause whose transition post-dated the citation, with the citation's own expiry clause unread); the heartbeat exemption ledger is guarded for date+length while the canary's stated '4x-daily' cadence is wrong against both rules that feed it; chronic=True warns are kept out of WarnCount forever, so a check that never once produced its measurement reported green for 30+ days; the axe baseline accepted serious rules on 08-02 and gates only NEW keys, its shrink signal has no consumer, and stale-in-the-good-direction entries silently disarm gating; a 14-day Maximum>=1 alarm is a 14-day mute on its own metric once one unfillable member enters. The entry is the instrument's memory of a past truth, and nothing asks whether it is still true.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: check_alarm_citations.py's rules are existence + #N-openness + recurrence-negative wording (the #3258 fix) — no timestamp or cause comparison; test_exemptions_are_dated_and_reasoned checks date+length, not the reason's factual content; the a11y ledger has a registry and a contract but no ratchet or dead-man (the #1990 mechanism recurring); qa-smoke's chronic tag is a permanent waiver with no expiry; the truth ledger's #2956 'a serious entry must name an issue' rule has no a11y twin.

prevention.what: One rule in CONVENTIONS §9: a waiver is a claim with a CONDITION and an EXPIRY, and the gate that honours it re-derives the condition, never the entry's existence. Concretely: citations carry `cause` (qa-smoke check id / StateReason fingerprint) and `added`, and check_alarm_citations fails any lit alarm whose StateTransitionedTimestamp > added or whose current cause ≠ cited cause; exemption entries that state a frequency are parsed and compared to the CDK/script schedule literal by AST; chronic=True warns join a 30-day 'never non-chronic' ratchet that must be empty; a11y baseline serious/critical entries require an `issue` field (the #2956 twin) and a `phase_dependent` flag on EXPERIMENT_SCOPED pages; alarms whose lookback exceeds their cadence must alarm on a 'new since last run' series derived from persisted state (OBS-5's NewInteriorGapCount) or carry an owner-writable expected-absence marker.
prevention.where: scripts/check_alarm_citations.py + docs/alarm_citations.json schema; tests/test_heartbeat_completeness.py (test_exemptions_are_dated_and_reasoned); tests/test_a11y_audit.py; lambdas/operational/qa_smoke_lambda.py chronic handling + a tests/ ratchet reading the qa-smoke log; cdk/stacks/monitoring_stack.py for the lookback rule with an AST test
prevention.negative_control: Offline: a synthetic alarm with StateTransitionedTimestamp after `added` → citation gate FAIL; age a shrink candidate to 8 days in a fixture report.json → wrap reds; set an exemption reason to '4x-daily' against a rate(1 hour) literal → heartbeat test reds; a serious a11y entry without `issue` → red. Positive controls: the same entries with matching cause/date/issue stay green.
prevention.missing_primitive: Dead-man on the ledger entry itself, and a ratchet (entries only shrink, with an owner)
prevention.rent_estimate: $0 — all at wrap (e10)/(e11) and in CI; OBS-5's second series is one existing-metric emission, no new alarm cost beyond ~$0.10/mo if added, with the demote below

detection.what: Wrap (e10) already runs every session; with the timestamp/cause rule it names a stale citation the same day the alarm re-fires. For the a11y ledger, the standalone visual-qa run already writes report.json's shrink list — the wrap battery reads it (no new run).
detection.rent_estimate: seconds per wrap
detection.demote_trigger: For OBS-5's optional NewInteriorGapCount alarm (if the owner takes it over the marker): retire it if a quarter passes with zero interior gaps on any source

root_cause_classes.name: Closed on merge, not on first real output — a fail-soft instrument is declared 'realized' when its PR merges, and nothing requires the instrument's own first non-degraded measurement
root_cause_classes.thesis: The closure contract grades whether the Outcome sentence came true and whether residuals are homed; `**Shipped:** … <live evidence>` is free text. So #1956/#2378 closed on the IAM grant being MERGED while GetObject kept returning AccessDenied and the check never produced a rate; #2254 moved a status write into a sender whose role lacks PutItem and the public status row read '44d ago' for a month; #1480's dedup sentinel was denied on every run for 49 days at 'non-fatal'; #532's commitment grader logged kept=0 broken=0 for 21 consecutive days with no metric; #2877's fast-follow was never ticketed; ADR-153's reclassification shipped without the reconcile that would have cleared 26 tombstoned cross-phase rows; the #3485 live repair inherited the slug-keyed blind spot it was repairing. A fail-soft path degrades to the status quo, so a broken one is indistinguishable from a working one — the platform recorded this as 'fail-closed paths need a LIVE proof' after #3200 and the class recurred six times in this review.
root_cause_classes.why_existing_gates_missed: scripts/closure_contract.py has six rules, none about the instrument; the `Live:` acceptance box exists only when a filer remembers it (the review's filings carry it — #3502 box 4, #3529 box 4 — Session U's #3474 did not); charter rule 4 scopes the dead-man to 'every scheduled thing', so a fail-soft WRITE path is outside its letter; the only alarm on the checkers watches AWS/Lambda Errors, which a swallowed exception never increments; 'merged is not deployed' is a memory note and the /land skill's step 5 asks about the Outcome sentence, not the first output.

prevention.what: (1) Closure-contract rule 8 `first-output-observed`: when the merged PR's diff touches an instrument (monitoring_stack alarms, qa_smoke checks, EMF emitters, any put/update inside a try/except that logs and continues — AST-detectable), the closing comment must carry `first non-degraded output: <timestamp> <where>` or `not-yet-observed — carrier #N` (a partial, so the issue stays open); detector in closure_sweep.py and check_pr_closing_set.py, advisory→block on the existing flip bar. (2) check_backlog_hygiene.py: an issue whose acceptance names an alarm/check/sweep/sensor must carry a `Live:` box. (3) Charter rule 4 amended: 'every scheduled thing AND every fail-soft path gets a dead-man at birth' — /new-machinery's question 5 reworded to ask it of writes that swallow errors.
