over_engineering_flags.alternative: Fold the T+writers re-verify into the existing daily standalone visual-qa fire with a `day_n ≤ 2` branch (it already fetches the served surface and already has the reader-truth judge), or into the nightly qa_smoke leg proposed under SDLC-B. No new schedule.

over_engineering_flags.proposal: DERIVED_ARTIFACTS rule 'ALWAYS tombstone-overwrite + 301-register any live /journal/posts/week-NN/ absent from the new posts.json' plus the served assertion 'newest posts.json/moments entry date ≥ genesis while day_n ≥ 0'
over_engineering_flags.why: Both collide with sanctioned honest states: #3512 already makes prior-cycle permalinks carry archive notices (a labelled archive is honest; a 301 to a redirect map is less informative to a reader than 'this is cycle 14's article'), and pre-genesis 'Prologue · Part N' installments are by design (card_engine.py:353; CPO-5 is a bug because the email DROPS that label). As written the assertion reds the honest prologue on Day 0 and gets waived — ORACLE-5's class on day one.
over_engineering_flags.rent_if_kept: $0; a check that fires on honest content and is then exempted, or a purge that deletes a labelled archive
over_engineering_flags.alternative: Registry decides per artifact (archive-with-notice vs purge); the served assertion verifies the LABEL — every pre-genesis or prior-cycle entry carries the Prologue/prior-cycle notice and maps to a visible non-tombstoned record — never the absence; archive_one keyed on (slug, cycle) with DA-C2's work contract (acted==0 on a cycle with published content is red).

over_engineering_flags.proposal: Delta-review row selection gains an EVENT term so the 8 reset-touching lenses run on every delta whose range contains a reset
over_engineering_flags.why: Resets are weekly (12 in 55 days), so this makes every weekly delta a near-full review of 8+ rows; the review's token cost is real rent — the cost lens found 63% of August's stamped AI spend was ci+dev, and each full row is an Opus fan-out plus adversarial verification.
over_engineering_flags.rent_if_kept: Roughly a doubling of weekly review tokens while resets stay weekly (unmeasured; inferred from the 08-09/08-16 delta shapes)
over_engineering_flags.alternative: One Day-0 sample of the 8 reset-touching rows per GENESIS (the first delta after it), the 28-day carry-forward cap, day-of-cycle stamped in the artifact, and an explicit 'anchors frozen' flag for any run the owner wants to compare to a prior one. If resets remain weekly, the honest lever is fewer resets, not more reviews.

framing_critique.what_is_wrong: (1) 'Why did we have silent issues?' looks for a culprit; silence is the DESIGNED output of four postures the platform chose — fail-soft writes that log 'non-fatal' (INT-1 49 days, G-3 28 days), a closure contract in warn mode, verification at one instant before the writers run, and acknowledgement ledgers keyed by name — there is no cause to find, only defaults to flip. (2) 'What would have stopped them going to production?' assumes a deploy boundary; by the SDLC analyst's count 58 of 99 entered at implementation where no gate could see them and 18 were WRITTEN BY production after a green verify (the 18:00Z sweep, the recap writer, og_moments) — production produced them, they did not go to it. (3) 'A one-time review created 70' is a spike that is not a spike: per-lens yield is flat (5.9 / 3.9 / 5.8 findings per lens across 08-09, 08-16, 09-05); 70 is 17 lenses instead of 7, sampled at Day 0 of a reset for the first time ever, and every one of the 17 A anchors was EXTENDED on the day — so '13 dropped a grade' is confounded by a raised bar on a never-observed surface and is not a measurement of decay. (4) 'Do another full review exactly the same and hit all A' is incoherent as stated: the rubric extends anchors each run, so the bar moves by construction; four A anchors are OUTCOMES that need time or readers, not code — cpo's 'an instrument that can grade whether coaching moved behavior' needs cycles longer than its 7–90-day windows (M2), narrative's 'one coherent cycle story' needs a cycle, growth's 'commercial option value real and measured' needs a market, qs's 'thresholds from personal variance' needs weigh-in adherence above 14 in 65 days; and two anchors (cto, observability) still cite a historical $85 ceiling. (5) The over-engineering exception measures rent in dollars; the 26 STANDING_RENT items across the four reports total under $3/month, while the real rent on this platform is attention (every new alarm is a citation to rot) and session wall-clock (the pre-push hook alone is ~6h/fortnight). (6) Missing from the framing entirely: the reset cadence. CYCLE_GENESES records 12 resets in 55 days against a PROPORTIONALITY row that prices the machinery at 'a few times a quarter'; 39 of 99 findings and 6 of 7 P1s live in the reset→Day-1 window; and the reset is an OWNER choice, not a defect.
framing_critique.what_to_add: (a) The reset cadence as an explicit, priced variable: either the reset is a weekly event with weekly-grade verification (T+writers re-verify, writer-side provenance, censoring-aware statistics) or resets become rare — both are legitimate, neither is free, and no prevention plan is honest without choosing. (b) The honesty test for every proposed guard: 'does a reader see something truer, or does a dashboard go green?' — 37 of 99 findings were defects IN instruments; a plan that adds instruments without ORACLE-1's per-entrant proof ratchet grows the estate that produced them. (c) Time-on-surface as the metric instead of issue count: for each class, how many days a false statement can stay on the published surface (today: 49 / 28 / 30+ / 21 days for the dead instruments, ~10h for the tombstone resurrection, 33 days for the /data proof stamp); the target is 'no lie survives one cadence'. (d) A frozen-anchor rule for any re-run the owner wants to compare, plus day-of-cycle in the artifact so Day 0 and Day N are graded as different instants — otherwise 'identical re-run' is unmeasurable. (e) A definition of done for a CLASS: a positive control that fails today, a denominator derived from a registry, and a first live observation on the published surface — the three things none of the 84 issues' acceptance boxes require together. (f) The owner acts no code substitutes for: apply the IAM JSON (SEC-4, #3336 rule), verify averagejoematt.com in SES (G-9), the DA-9 reconcile write, weigh-in adherence (QS-5's floor), the 'curated 20 vs registry 22' ruling (G-6), and the reset-frequency decision. (g) Recognise that the review already IS the proactive instrument the owner asks for — the question is its sampling design (cadence, instant, frozen anchors), not its existence.
framing_critique.what_to_drop: (a) 'Why' as a search for a cause — replace with the four postures and their flips. (b) 'Stop them going to production' — replace with 'make production unable to lie for longer than one cadence'. (c) 'All A' as the goal — replace with 'an identical re-run, anchors frozen, on Day 0 AND Day 14, finds zero P1/P2 and every P3 lands in a class with an owner and a positive control'; an A that the same instrument awards when it finds nothing is the vacuous-pass class applied to the review itself. (d) Issue count as the score — 70 vs 7 says nothing if the 7 are tombstone resurrections on the story door. (e) The implicit assumption that the 84 issues are the work: the ~10 class rules that survive this critique are; each makes 5–20 of the 84 closable by construction and several redundant, and the remaining instance fixes should be closed by the class PR, not one at a time at a 9-hour median. (f) The dollar-only reading of 'over-engineering' — demand the demote trigger and the attention cost of every new alarm and every new residue ledger, including the ones the existing acknowledgement layers already carry.

redteam.path_to_A_reality_check: FREE and honestly reachable with the class rules above (12 of 17): principal (path-scoped pre-push hook + per-entrant proof ratchet + dead-def guard extension; but note the bypass actor is the OWNER's account, so the hook is a local, --no-verify-able promise — A here is partly owner discipline, not code), aiq (PRESTART registry value + facet-preserving inventory + UNEVALUATED judge outcome, all landed or landable in tests; the judge's $0.193/run is existing rent), designer (lift 19 tokens.css rules, derive TEXT_FLOOR_PAGES and the scroll assertion from qa_manifest — design labour, $0), dataviz (charts.js contract test + survival fix + coverage_hold flags), qs to A- (season⊆frozen, stratified reference Brier, claim-shape classifier, PRESTART; full A blocked on data — 14 weigh-ins in 65 days cannot yield a personal-variance threshold the platform can defend, an owner-behaviour act), reader (labels for prior-cycle content, placeholder fix, n-bounded survival), security (all FREE tests + two owner acts: apply the IAM JSON per the no-hand-twin rule, move the reader-input queue prefix), a11y (CSS + composite contrast pairs + ledger `issue` field + light-context axe pass at ~2–3 free CI minutes per deploy), cost (scope label on the projection, per-feature dollars from the series already metered, threshold re-derived from the trailing 8-week baseline — all FREE; #3373's kill switch is L effort but $0), data-architect (census-derived coverage, writer-side stamping, work contract per reset step; the DA-9 reconcile is an OWNER WRITE to DDB), devex (mirror-derivation contract family, value-keyed fact rules, concurrency keyed on sha), integrations (IAM-parity set, registry-derived DAILY_SOURCES, behavioral facet in the classifier; Garmin stays paused by vendor and is disclosed, MacroFactor's 72-day dark is an owner upload). NEED SMALL STANDING RENT or a session-independent actor (2 of 17): cto and observability — the reader-audience alarms routed to the existing urgent topic is FREE, the daily canary is ~$0.05/mo more, the citation `cause` rule is FREE; but both A anchors require that a red REACHES A HUMAN and is explained within ~72h independent of any session — in September's no-session posture that is either the remediation agent's cron (existing, $0.18/run) or the owner reading email; and both anchors must be repaired to the $215 ceiling before they can be met at all. CANNOT REACH A BY ENGINEERING (3 of 17): cpo — its A requires an instrument that grades coaching→behavior, and CPO-2's commitments need cycles longer than their 7–90-day windows while the median cycle is ~5 days (M2): no code lights it; narrative — 'one coherent cycle story with reset seams invisible' needs a cycle that lasts, and the voice-fidelity scoreboard needs reader evidence; growth — 'commercial option value real and measured' and a funnel with real conversions are market outcomes; C+ → B+ is the honest ceiling on Day 0 with the derived-copy fixes, plus one owner act (SES identity + three DNS records). WHAT 'AN IDENTICAL RE-RUN HITS ALL A' WOULD ACTUALLY REQUIRE: (1) a rubric decision to FREEZE the 17 anchors for that run — today extension-per-run is the rule, so the bar moves by construction and 'identical' is unmeasurable; (2) sampling the same instant — Day 0 of a reset — which means another reset, the largest single producer of defects; the coherent version grades Day 0 and Day 14 as two instants and requires both; (3) at least one cycle ≥ 30 days so cpo/qs/narrative/growth have data rather than censored windows; (4) six owner acts (IAM JSON, SES identity, DA-9 reconcile, the curated-count ruling, weigh-in adherence, the reset-frequency decision); (5) the ~10 class rules landed with their positive controls failing first — ORACLE-1's per-entrant ratchet, the IAM-parity set, the writer-side provenance guard with PRESTART, the served-surface contract reading CDN bytes and verifying labels, the per-step work contract, the label-derivation rule (M1), the censoring rule (M2), the pre-seal truth gate (M3), the citation `cause`/staleness rule, and the positive-control-over-tests rule; (6) accepting under $2/mo of new standing rent with stated demote triggers (daily canary, one runtime dead-man on commitments, optionally NewInteriorGapCount) and refusing the rest. Stated plainly: 'all A on an identical re-run' is incoherent for cpo, narrative and growth on any Day-0 sample under weekly resets, and is unmeasurable for every lens until the anchors are frozen; 'zero P1/P2 on a frozen-anchor Day-0 + Day-14 re-run' is coherent, mostly FREE, and is the goal to state.
redteam.the_70_answer: One review found 70 because it was the first instrument that graded the PUBLISHED surface at the instant it is most likely to lie — Day 0 of a reset, between the wipe at ~16:50Z and the first scheduled writer at 18:00Z — and asked of every number the ADR-105 question, "can the stated method produce this from the data shown?" Every standing instrument grades something else: metadata about the surface (a check ran, a citation exists by name, a rollup is green, a hash matches, a comment has the right shape) or the surface at one instant before 104 schedules rewrite it. The platform's honesty apparatus — ADR-104/105 labels, confidence strings, disclaimers, citations, "grounded" stamps — is prose, and prose was hand-typed, so in roughly a dozen findings the honesty marker itself was the lie ("n=2 is narrative" beside n=15, "CURED and PROVEN LIVE" over a new cause, "Real CGM data" over a null feed, "grounded in the plan" over magic numbers). Fail-soft writes and a warn-mode closure contract let four dead instruments read green for 21–49 days. And the reset — 12 in 55 days, priced as "a few times a quarter" — turned a rare Day-0 state into the platform's modal state and made right-censoring the dominant data condition no statistic models, which is why the more you reset the more confident the 47% got. The number 70 is not a spike: the yield per lens has been ~5–6 in every review; it is 17 lenses instead of 7, times the one instant nobody had ever looked at. The fix is not 70 issues; it is about ten class rules — most of them FREE tests that must fail today before they pass — plus one owner decision about how often the experiment restarts.

synthesis.the_70_answer:
One review found 70 things because it was the first instrument in five weeks to ask "does this work live, today, after a reset" across all 17 areas at once, and it asked on the worst possible day.

The count is not a spike. Every review since July has found about 5–6 confirmed findings per lens (41 across 7 lenses, 27 across 7, now 99 across 17). What changed: 17 lenses ran instead of 7; ten of them had not been graded from scratch since late July while ~600 commits a fortnight and twelve resets went by; and the run landed on Day 0 of a reset, ten hours after a scheduled writer had republished a post the reset had erased — a moment no previous review had ever sampled. Every grader also raised its own bar the same day, so part of "13 dropped" is a higher bar, not decay.

They were not silent; they were unread. Your instruments measure the diff, the merge, the closing comment's shape and the count of gates. The defects live in served bytes, a write IAM denied for 49 days, a caption that stopped matching its number, a cron writing after the reset's green snapshot. Half of main lands by direct push meeting only a formatter; issues close on merge, nine hours after filing; 538 of 597 gates have never been shown able to fail; alarm citations match by name, not cause.

The fix is not seventy repairs and not thirty new detectors. It is six changes to how work lands, closes and is graded — almost all free — plus one decision only you can make: how often the experiment resets. Twelve resets in 55 days on machinery priced for "a few times a quarter" produced six of the seven P1s.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 1. The ungated landing path
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: Half of main (302 of 613 commits since 08-22; 146 by the session account, 179 code-touching) arrives by direct push that meets only the black+ruff pre-commit hook. deploy/agent_commit.sh runs no pytest, no pre-push hook exists, the ADR-148 bypass actor is the owner's own account, ci-cd's deploy needs only the critical lane (ADR-117) so a red full suite still ships, and the PR template (line 19) literally asks for the targeted-pytest behaviour that redded main twice on 09-04. The reset pipeline and the wrap are direct pushes whose local stand-ins ran a hand-listed subset of CI (one doc gate vs twelve; 4 of 12). 26 of 29 red Unit-Test runs on main in 14 days were direct pushes.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE. deploy/agent_commit.sh --push REFUSES code-touching direct pushes to main (open a PR — the fast-lane already runs 8,813 premerge tests there for free) and runs the derived docs_ci_gate_commands() set (seconds) for docs-only pushes; the reset pipeline is the one sanctioned code pusher and gets an explicit env bypass plus the AST-derived set of tests that read deploy/generated/** (#3529). One ci_gate_commands(workflow) function every stand-in imports, with a test that enumerates every script that calls git push and asserts it imports it. docs-ci/v4-gate concurrency keyed on github.sha for push events (#3533). PR template line 19 replaced. Negative control: a commit touching lambdas/x.py pushed to main is refused naming the path; a docs-only commit that breaks sync_doc_metadata --check is refused; a green docs commit pushes in <30s.
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. The wrap battery's (e2) main-green gate prints the trailing-7d count of red Unit-Test runs on main whose head is not a PR merge (one gh read) and the same line goes into the remediation agent's existing Mon/Wed/Fri report so it is read in a no-session week. No third reader beyond that.
root_cause_classes_final.rent_estimate: $0 AWS; seconds per docs push, zero per code push (code goes through the PR lane that already runs)
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP, MODIFIED by 5 of 6 personas: the 155s-on-every-push hook was rejected (26 min/day of session wall-clock, --no-verify-able, duplicates the PR lane; the 'hook is installed' test cannot fail in CI). Adopted the refuse-not-test form (SRE, founder, cost, critic) with path scoping (rigor). #3528 is amended to this shape rather than refiled. Dissent recorded: DE kept the full-lane hook; overridden because the PR lane already exists and the refusal removes the path rather than adding a step it can skip.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 2. The reset is a read-side, point-in-time contract; writers and derived artifacts have none
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: ADR-077 is a READ contract (with_phase_filter in 76 files, three generations of reader ratchets) with no writer side: 112 files put/update, 26 stamp provenance, #2119's writer guard covers COACH#/ENSEMBLE# put_item only, 31 writer seams on scoped partitions sit in pair_seam_residue with no countdown, and experiment_stamp() returns the constant phase and SSM's already-bumped cycle before genesis. The reset's three gates prove the served surface once at ~16:50Z; the chronicle sweep (18:00Z, status+age selector), og-image, the recap writer and insight writers rewrite it hours later. Derived S3 artifacts (week-NN pages, share kits, OG cards, catalogs) have no class and a slug-keyed archive that has archived nothing since cycle 4 (html_files_archived=0 / already_archived=29, reported as success). The only writer-side check (restart_verify check 14) is attended and was never run for cycle 15. Six of the seven P1s are this class.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE. Three one-function fixes first: (1) the wipe flips status->voided on every draft it tombstones so an age-keyed selector cannot re-select it; (2) experiment_stamp(as_of)/tag_record derive phase from as_of >= EXPERIMENT_START_DATE (pre-genesis writes stamp pilot, hidden by every existing filter) — never from the SSM cycle constant; (3) archive_one keyed on (slug, cycle) with a per-step WORK CONTRACT: every restart_* step reports {input, acted, skipped} and the pipeline reds on input>0 ∧ acted==0 without a named reason. Then: restart_verify semantic check 6 sweeps the classify()==EXPERIMENT_SCOPED families from a step-0 pk_family_census.json (the wipe's coverage assertion derives from it, not from OPERATIONAL_COACH_IDS); a per-ENTRANT scoped-writer guard (new writers must stamp; the 31 existing seams get a dated expiry each); og_moments purges kits whose canonical_url left posts.json; a pre-seal truth gate (baseline == constants, every coach ∈ the operational registry, season ids ⊆ frozen, min_effect carries {sd, n}) that refuses to seal on red. T+24h re-curl lives in the existing #3390 cloud routine (no AWS). Negative controls: a tombstoned draft inside the 48h..10d window must NOT be returned by _find_stale_drafts and the identical un-tombstoned one MUST; a write with as_of = genesis-1 that lands phase=experiment fails; a fixture week-NN page older than the reset and absent from posts.json reds restart_verify; archive_one on a slug with a cycle-4 archive must archive again under cycle-16 (fails today).
root_cause_classes_final.detection: STANDING RENT ≈$0. ONE nightly census leg inside the already-scheduled qa_smoke_lambda (pre-genesis provenance census over the census families; served posts.json == visible DDB set; moments/index.json ⊆ posts.json; every 200 under /journal/posts/week-NN/ is in posts.json OR carries the #3512 archive notice — verify the LABEL, never absence, because Prologue installments are pre-genesis by design). Landed only AFTER #3501's cause identity (qa-smoke writes its failing check ids to the existing run artifact) so it does not join an alarm that is lit today under a wrong citation.
root_cause_classes_final.rent_estimate: ≈$0.01/mo (~40 key-bounded DDB reads + ~10 HTTPS HEADs per night inside a Lambda already paid for; no new alarm, rides FailCount). Demote: two consecutive resets AND 60 nights with zero findings while the writer-guard residue is at zero → fold into restart_verify check 6 and retire the nightly leg.
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP (unanimous as the P1 class) with MERGE of SDLC-B + EM-5 + DA-C1/C2/C3/C6 and three KILLs honoured: the DERIVED_ARTIFACTS registry (killed by founder + DE as a sixth registry with its own hand twin — replaced by cycle-keyed archive + one restart_verify assertion), restart-reverify.yml (killed by all six — replaced by the existing cloud routine), and five separate nightly qa-smoke legs (collapsed to one, sequenced after cause identity per SRE/rigor/critic). The full writer AST sweep with a 31–69-entry residue ledger was deferred to per-entrant form (DE/critic). Rigor's correction adopted: the served assertion checks labels, not absence.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 3. Closed on merge, never observed producing; tested over a fake wire
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: Fixes #N closes the issue at merge, before deploy; closure_contract.py is DEFAULT_MODE='warn' with a flip bar never met and six rules that grade the closing comment's shape, none of which asks for a first live output; median open->close is 9.0h and 186 of 229 close inside 24h, so the first real run is always after the close. A fail-soft write (a put_item in a try/except that logs 'non-fatal') degrades to the status quo and is indistinguishable from a working one in every test (a FakeDdbTable cannot deny a write) and every alarm (an Errors alarm sees no error). INT-1's sentinel write was IAM-denied on every run for 49 days; G-3's status write since 08-08 while /api/status read '44d ago'; OBS-1's check never once produced its measurement; CPO-2's grader logged kept=0 broken=0 for 21 days with its only test mocking the grader; #3477 closed 'realized' and its class recurred that afternoon.
root_cause_classes_final.workflow_stage: closure (and PR review for the fake-wire half)
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE. (a) Remove the mechanism rather than police it: a PR whose diff touches an instrument, an alarm, a scheduled job, or a fail-soft write uses `Refs #N`, never `Fixes #N` — the issue closes by hand when the first non-degraded live output is pasted (PR template, issue-filer, /land §5: one line each). (b) The closure contract's single `no-live-proof` code is armed BLOCK from day one (its false-positive cost is a reopened issue, never a lost fix); the other rules stay warn on the existing bar. Positive controls: the real #1480/#2254/#1956/#532 closing comments must all fail it. (c) The IAM-parity test generalised to a role family: for every role in role_policies*.py with LeadingKeys/action allowlists, AST-derive the owning module's DDB/S3/SES verbs and pk literals and assert containment, enrolled in the premerge lane — it must be RED today on INT-1's notion pk and G-3's PutItem (that is its positive control). (d) UNEVALUATED as a named judge outcome (landed, #3540).
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. One Logs Insights query in the existing weekly drift sentinel (or the remediation agent's Mon/Wed/Fri report, which already holds logs:FilterLogEvents): `level=ERROR|AccessDenied|non-fatal` count by @log over /aws/lambda/life-platform-* for 7d, printed with function names. Zero metrics, zero alarms. Catches an INT-1 within a week instead of never. If the commitment loop survives its owner decision, a qa-smoke DDB count (due>0 ∧ graded==0, only when cycle_age ≥ the grading window) rides FailCount at $0.
root_cause_classes_final.rent_estimate: $0 standing; Logs Insights bills per GB scanned — the checker logs are KB–MB, <$0.05/mo
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: MODIFIED by all six. Killed: four per-function ERROR MetricFilters + alarms (proposed by three analysts; $1.50–2.90/mo once custom-metric pricing is applied, and the OBS-5 saturation shape — INT-1 logged ERROR benignly every run), the CommitmentsGraded metric pair (saturates by construction under weekly resets; the loop is a demote candidate), the mock-of-subject AST detector, and closure rules 7/8 in warn mode. Adopted SRE/founder's `Refs not Fixes` and the rigor/critic/EM/DE position that ONLY the no-live-proof code flips to block. IAM-parity was the one unanimous KEEP in the whole panel.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 4. Guard the instance, not the set — and guards born unproven
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: An incident names one specimen; the session fixes that member and writes a guard pinned to it — one file (OBS-4: AlarmTypes fixed in restart_verify while four callers stayed blind), one page set (DES-2: the 11px floor on 3 of 89 pages), one sheet class (DES-4), one cohort (CTO-5), one source (INT-3: #2643 on eightsleep only), one relation of three (AIQ-1), one directory (SEC-1, R2), one hand list (DA-2: the wipe's coverage assertion compares two copies of the same hand list). 33 of 99 findings cite in their own class string the prior issue they re-instantiate; 'guard the SET' is the charter's own exemplar sentence and the most-repeated memory lesson (10+). Underneath: guards enter unproven because tests/test_gate_census_lane_3000.py ceilings the AGGREGATE (541 vs 536–538 live) — 'prove one, mint one' — so 597 gates carry 50 proofs and 35 of 101 recent source-scanning guards have no must-fail case.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE. (1) Per-ENTRANT proof ratchet (#3536): check_unproven_ceiling changes from 'aggregate ≤ 541' to 'no gate id new since the committed baseline is unproven' — honours owner decision #3329 (no retroactive programme over the 538) while closing the entrance; a new census gate ships with a gate_census_mutations.py --run recorded in PROVEN_CAN_FAIL. Un-vacuates the existing control: today one new unproven id under the ceiling passes. (2) Intake: the issue-filer emits a `## Set` section on every bug/story filed from a review or incident (the enumeration query + member count today) with one mandatory acceptance box 'the guard enumerates the set from source, N/N covered or residual folded onto #M'; check_backlog_hygiene lints the heading; worktree-implementer step 6b pastes the member list into the PR body; PR template asks 'name the SET this guard enumerates and the registry it derives from'. (3) The specific set-fixes as ordinary registry-derived tests, already filed (#3500 DLQ over Event-invoked targets, #3542/#3543 scroll + floor over qa_manifest, #3520 cast scan over deploy/+config/, #3504 absence marker over every DAILY_SOURCE, #3514 census-derived wipe coverage, #3503 done).
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. The wrap battery prints 'unproven gate ids new since baseline' as a marker line asserted by check_handover_lines, and the same line appears in the remediation agent's report so a no-session week still surfaces it.
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP (best-evidenced class; SDLC-D + TO-1 + TO-3 + EM-3 + DA-C5 merged). Killed by 3+ personas and dropped: the generic POSITIVE-CONTROL AST rule over tests/ (a wording heuristic — the #2959/#3003/#3199 suppressor family; satisfied by a decorative pytest.raises), the SCAN-SET rule / #2844 root expansion into tests/ scripts/ deploy/ (residue ledger goes from 36 to hundreds), closure rule 7 `set-named`, and three aggregate census counters at wrap (they carry the prove-one-mint-one hole three times). SRE's objection to `## Set` (process on a warn-mode contract) was overridden by five personas: it is a template plus a lint at the one moment a fresh-context agent is guaranteed to be reading. DE's deletion quota is adopted in structural change 6.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 5. Hand copies of a fact the platform already owns, on surfaces the derivation net does not reach
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: The derivation guard is real for Python consumers of four vocabularies (#2844) and for phrase-keyed doc facts (#2003), but reader-bound and agent-bound text lives outside it: the confirmation email said '19 sources' against 20 curated / 22 registry with no recorded semantic; /subscribe/ promised one Wednesday email while three CDK schedules deliver up to three, none on Wednesday; /api/explain built its own phase line beside the #1086 shared block; data_phase was a constant 'established'; the brief collapsed the registry's paused/lag facets to a binary so coaches invented a sync story; MEMORY.md said genesis 09-04 against constants 09-05 and both fact gates are phrase-keyed; wrap_gates hand-listed 4 of 12 CI gates; wait_pr_green restated YAML path filters as drifted regexes; a coverage header carried three eras of numbers; /data/'s proof stamp was 33 days old because its builder is not in the deploy's list.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE — DERIVE, do not detect. Each specimen becomes a consumer of its registry: templates read len(SOURCE_REGISTRY) with the curated-vs-registry semantic recorded once (#3565 done); /subscribe/ and the confirmation copy render from email_stack's schedule literal after the owner picks the cadence (#3564 done, #3568 owner); one phase line via build_experiment_phase_context (#3519); the brief inventory renders the paused/lag facet (#3516); CI stand-ins parse the workflow YAML (#3531, #3532 — the deterministic mirror-derivation contract, kept); the builder list in sync_site_to_s3.sh derived by glob over scripts/v4_build_*.py (#3515); a ddb_put()/ddb_update() wrapper that coerces Decimal with a shrink-only call-site allowlist (DA-1's class, #3569 fixed the instance). Wrap rule: every number in the CLAUDE.md status block that a doc-facts rule owns is emitted by `sync_doc_metadata --render-status` and pasted, never typed; and the /wrap skill STOPS writing genesis dates into memory prose (the boot brief prints it from constants) — subtract the copy rather than guard it. Negative controls: plant '19 sources' in an email template → the enrolled truth test reds; remove one gate from wrap_gates' derived list → the ⊇ test reds.
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. Docs CI already runs on every docs push; the gap was its verdict being cancelled (#3533) and read as no-signal (#3530, done). No new sweep.
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: MODIFIED by all six: the served-string numeric regex ('any <int> in a served payload must equal a field'), the ±60-day value-keyed genesis rule over MEMORY.md/CLAUDE.md/.claude/skills, and widening #2844's vocabularies+roots into config/ deploy/ site/assets/js/ templates/ tests/js were each killed by 4+ personas as the phrase-matched-suppressor family in new clothes (DEVEX-5 is its fifth field failure) with a residue explosion. Kept: derive-at-source for the specimens, the YAML mirror-derivation contract, the render-status wrap rule, the Decimal wrapper (DE's form). Rigor's dissent (reader-bound surfaces deserve the structural rule) is honoured by scoping the ONE served-string rule to captions in class 6.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 6. The statistic and its caption have two authors — arithmetic no gate can see
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: The two QA layers that touch numbers are a render sweep (overflow, reveals) and a prose judge (does the sentence match the fact set); neither can see a goal entering a y-domain (slope flattened ~30x, two doors printing opposite verdicts on the same 2.25 lb), two series index-positioned to the same width, a placeholder 50.0 plotted as a vertex, a 47% 'odds of day 30' where every survivor is a censored 1–7-day cycle (`cd is None` has no horizon check) beside a hand-typed 'n=2' next to len(priors)=15, a pooled base rate manufacturing Brier skill across two unskilled strata, 'recover' substring-matching 'recovery' so a level claim grades as a 14-day up-trend, literal min_effect inside a 'grounded' prereg, a step count invisible to a unit-token regex. ADR-105 ('uncertainty + n on every claim') has no executable owner in CONVENTIONS §9; the honesty label itself — 'n=2 is narrative', 'well-calibrated', 'Real CGM data. Updated daily.', a false receipts disclaimer — was hand-typed beside the number it describes, so in a dozen findings the honesty marker IS the lie. Only one test file imports charts.js.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE — contract tests on pure functions, with fixtures that fail TODAY. A Node-executed charts.js contract in the Unit Tests job (precedent tests/test_cockpit_scope_history_2672.py): y-domain identical with/without goal; equal-date points share x; no marker beyond its own scale; not_instrumented axes omitted (#3556/#3557 done, #3496 epic). An ADR-105 emission contract scoped to the endpoints that serve a probability/skill/projection/composition (survival, calibration, receipts, predictions, body-comp — ~6 by grep, NOT all 121 schemas): a `method` OBJECT {n, denominator/censoring rule, strata, scope} built by the same function as the number, captions rendered FROM it, api_schemas requiring it there; a literal-string lint on `"confidence":`/`"method":` values in lambdas/web (≥6 exist today). Fixtures: all-censored 1–7-day priors → p30 ≤ (reached+1)/(n+2) (fails today at 47%); two strata 0.5/22% and 0.8/79% → pooled 'skilled' must be None (fails today); 'approximately 53.5% on September 5th' must not be typed directional (fails today); mutate priors 2→3 and the served n must move. Censoring corollary to ADR-105 rule 4: a window longer than the trailing median cycle length is born 'ungradeable at this cadence', never 'pending'. CONVENTIONS §9 gains the row naming the survival bound test as ADR-105's owner. A test that asserts a disclaimer asserts its CONDITION (#3555).
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE — none new. A pure function does not drift; the contract test is the detector. The reader-truth judge's existing daily fire remains the prose catch-all with its deterministic temporal rule registered in the freshness class (#3517).
root_cause_classes_final.rent_estimate: $0; ~10s of node in the Unit Tests job
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP (unanimous; 'the model answer for cost posture' — cost persona). SDLC-F + DA-C4 + rigor's M1 (the label is a literal) + M2 (reset-induced censoring) merged. Modified per founder/DE/critic/cost: the 'method object on EVERY served statistic' across 121 schemas was scoped to the named endpoints; DA-C4's nightly 'n=<int>' regex over live payloads dropped (once the caption derives from the object the check can only pass).

root_cause_classes_final.name: 7. A waiver, citation, exemption or deferral outlives its condition — and has no carrier
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: Every acknowledgement layer is a ledger entry checked for existence and date, never re-derived against the condition it claims: docs/alarm_citations.json is matched by alarm NAME (qa-smoke-failures lit 09-03 on a new cause under a 09-01 citation saying 'CURED and PROVEN LIVE'; no `cause` field, no StateTransitionedTimestamp comparison); heartbeat exemptions are checked for date+length while the canary's stated '4x-daily' cadence is wrong against both rules that feed it; chronic=True warns are excluded from WarnCount forever; the axe baseline accepts serious rules indefinitely because nothing requires an `issue` field, and its shrink list has no consumer; a 14-day Maximum≥1 alarm mutes itself; the remediation agent renews the same needs-human line verbatim (9×, 93×) with no terminal condition. The same shape in prose: 'revisit', 'fast-follow', 'step 4', 'measure clean first then extend', 'owner decides' written in ADRs, PROPORTIONALITY rows, closing comments and path-to-A ledgers with no issue number and no date (a11y-3's July step 4, DES-2's no-clock extension, #2877's fast-follow, ADR-133's revisit clause, PROPORTIONALITY row 52: 'two triggers had already fired unnoticed'). The platform owns the primitive — operating_calendar.py's dated obligations — and never pointed it at these.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE. One CONVENTIONS §9 rule: a waiver is a claim with a CONDITION and an EXPIRY, and the gate that honours it re-derives the condition. Concretely: citations carry `cause` + `added`; check_alarm_citations fails any lit alarm whose StateTransitionedTimestamp > added or whose current cause ≠ cited cause (#3501); qa-smoke writes its failing check ids to the existing run artifact so cause is readable (NOT an EMF dimension per check — $4.50/mo); chronic warns join a 30-day never-non-chronic ratchet that must be empty; a11y serious/critical entries require `issue` (#3546/#3548, the #2956 twin) and the wrap reads the shrink artifact; exemption reasons that state a frequency are parsed against the schedule literal (#3506); the interior-gap alarm's condition is removed by applying the #2643 absence marker to every DAILY_SOURCE from the registry (#3504) rather than instrumented. Deferral carrier: an obligation vocabulary (revisit / owner decides / fast-follow / step N / later — structural because the vocabulary is the registry, the check_residual_queue precedent) in ADRs, PROPORTIONALITY, alarm_citations, exemptions and closing comments must cite #N or a date within 90 days; every Load-bearing PROPORTIONALITY row carries `demote_by:` or `demote_when:` probed by operating_calendar; the closure contract's `residual-homed` code flips to block now. Residue-ledger rule: one registry of residue/allowlist ledgers with a shared test that every entry carries an issue/expiry and every ledger has a shrink consumer — and no new ledger enters without it (this is the rule most of the killed proposals would have violated). Negative controls: a synthetic alarm transitioned after `added` → FAIL; a serious a11y entry without `issue` → red; 'revisit when traffic grows' in an ADR with no #N → red; a row with 'revisit 2026-11-01' and no calendar probe → red.
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. Wrap (e10) and Docs CI already run these scripts; the operating calendar's daily probe already dead-mans rituals — pointed at rent rows it names the rotted trigger the day it passes.
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP (unanimous — Oracle-5 plus the four independently named missing classes SRE-M4, founder-M3, DE-M4, critic-M3, cost-M2). Killed within it: NewInteriorGapCount metric + alarm (all six → absence marker), per-check EMF dimensions on qa-smoke (cost: $4.50/mo → write ids to the existing artifact). Critic's point adopted as the class's own rule: every residue ledger the other proposals would have created is this class on the day it lands.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 8. The review instrument itself — grades carried forward, anchors moved in-run, no negative control
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: The review is the platform's only from-scratch measurement and the intake for most of its backlog (84 of 297 issues since 08-22), and its sampling design made 09-05 inevitable: 8 of 17 lenses were last graded from scratch on 07-28/08-02 and carried forward by name through the 08-09 and 08-16 deltas ('grades stand'); the 08-27 delta was held for an instrument rewrite, so no review of any breadth ran 08-16→09-05; delta rows are selected by diff paths, so a reset — which touches no path but rewrites the world — never selects the narrative/CPO/reader rows; every prior review ran on Day 1–6 and this was the first on Day 0. The designer's prior A- was measured on 7 of 89 pages. Every one of the 17 A anchors was EXTENDED in the run that graded against it (SKILL.md sanctions this), so how much of '13 dropped' is decay cannot be separated from the artifact. The refutation rate fell 50%→10% with no calibration — nothing distinguishes better verification from compliant verifiers. full.md makes finding something a success condition, so a 17-A run fails the review's own bar; yield has been ~5.8/lens at every breadth regardless of platform state.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE (no added review runs). (1) Anchors live in a versioned rubric file, frozen for a run, extended only by PR between runs. (2) A carried-forward grade may not be carried past 28 days — operating_calendar's probe reads `unchanged_lenses` ages from the newest grades JSON and forces the row into the next delta. (3) Day-of-cycle recorded in `method` (done 09-05 — keep). (4) Negative controls for the review: 2–3 planted false findings per verifier batch (a true claim written as a defect) and 2–3 known open issues withheld from the do-not-refile list; a run whose verifiers confirm a planted false finding is marked UNCALIBRATED and does not reset the calendar clock. (5) B-class path-to-A items are filed OR explicitly declined with a reason at Phase 4 — never silently dropped, never mandatory-filed. (6) A PROPORTIONALITY row for the review ritual itself with measured session-hours and tokens per full run and a demote trigger. The 'reset event term' is NOT adopted while resets are weekly (it would make every delta a near-full review); at most one Day-0 sample of the reset-touching rows per genesis, after the cadence decision.
root_cause_classes_final.detection: FREE. The boot brief prints 'lenses not graded from scratch in >28d: [...]' from the calendar probe that already runs at SessionStart and wrap.
root_cause_classes_final.rent_estimate: $0 — changes which rows a delta selects, adds no runs
root_cause_classes_final.red_team_disposition: KEEP (EM-7 was the only analyst to name it; all six personas kept it as the honest answer to 'why 70'). MODIFIED per rigor/DE/cost: the event term dropped as unpriced review-token rent under weekly resets; critic's M4 (the review has no negative control) and the frozen-anchor rule added; SRE's 'filed or declined, not mandatory' adopted for B items.

root_cause_classes_final.name: 9. The reset cadence exceeds the machinery's design cadence (an owner decision, not machinery)
root_cause_classes_final.thesis: CYCLE_GENESES holds 16 entries; 12 resets in 55 days; cycles 13/14/15 lasted 15/15/3 days; the 09-04 Friday reset was a typo re-anchored the next day. PROPORTIONALITY row 86 prices the reset sweep for 'a few times a quarter'. ~39 of 99 findings and 6 of 7 P1s live in the reset→first-cron window; every future-genesis reset re-mints the countdown-window class; principal-03's fixture is 'broken BY the reset every single time'; CTO-3 is the #1985 class on its THIRD reset; NARR-5/G-1 recur every reset since cycle 4. Two findings are the cadence leaking into the product: the 47% survival odds are seven 1–7-day re-anchored cycles counted as day-30 survivors (the more you reset, the more confident the number), and no commitment has ever reached its 7–90-day due date because resets tombstone them first (480 records, 0 graded). Narrative's A anchor ('one coherent cycle story, reset seams invisible') and QS's ('every bet graded or voided across resets') cannot be held under this cadence by any code. All four analysts converted this into writer-side machinery; none put the cadence to the owner.
root_cause_classes_final.prevention: FREE + OWNER ACT. Correct PROPORTIONALITY row 86 to the measured cadence (12/55 days) so every reset-machinery demote trigger is judged against the real number. restart_pipeline refuses a second --apply within N days of the last genesis unless --reanchor-of names it (a typo no longer costs a second full reset). stories.outcome: After #3501 lands cause identity (failing check ids written to the existing run artifact, not an EMF dimension), qa_smoke gains one check: pre-genesis provenance census over the census families (no scoped row dated < genesis without tombstone/phase=pilot; no CROSS_PHASE row carrying a phase stamp); served /journal/posts.json == the visible DDB chronicle set; moments/index.json ⊆ posts.json; every 200 under /journal/posts/week-NN/ ∈ posts.json OR carries the #3512 archive notice (label, never absence — Prologue installments are pre-genesis by design). Fetched through CloudFront, not S3.
acceptance: Planted status=draft row dated < genesis with no tombstone → FAIL naming the pk; the same row tombstoned → pass
A live week-NN page absent from posts.json and lacking the archive notice → FAIL; with the notice → pass
The check's id appears in the run artifact the citation gate reads
PROPORTIONALITY row with rent and the demote trigger below
stories.rent_estimate: ≈$0.01/mo (~40 key-bounded DDB reads + ~10 HEADs per night inside the existing Lambda; no new alarm). Demote: two consecutive resets AND 60 nights at zero while the scoped-writer residue is at zero → fold into restart_verify check 6 and delete the leg.

stories.title: Price and bound the reset: correct row 86, refuse a re-apply within N days without --reanchor-of, print resets/month and $/reset in the monthly close — and the owner rules on cadence
stories.problem: 12 resets in 55 days against PROPORTIONALITY row 86's 'a few times a quarter'; 39 of 99 findings and 6 of 7 P1s live in the reset→first-cron window; the 09-04 typo cost a second full reset; the 47% survival odds are the cadence counted as day-30 survivors; no commitment has ever reached its due date. No row prices the reset EVENT and no analyst put the cadence to the owner.
stories.outcome: Row 86 states the measured cadence so every reset-machinery demote trigger is judged against 12/quarter; restart_pipeline refuses --apply within N days of the last genesis unless --reanchor-of names it; scripts/monthly_close.py prints resets this month, $ per reset (visual-qa full pass + truth pass + CDK deploys with vision QA), findings-per-reset from the last review, and DEMOTE candidates (instruments with zero non-degraded output in 30 days: the commitment loop, canary-precision, the two unreachable Errors alarms). The owner decides: rare resets (monthly+), or weekly resets with weekly-grade verification and censoring-aware statistics — recorded as an ADR amendment either way.
acceptance: Dry --apply 3 days after a genesis without --reanchor-of exits non-zero naming the prior genesis; with the flag it proceeds
monthly_close output carries the four lines; a synthetic instrument with a zero-output ledger appears as a DEMOTE candidate, one with an output does not
Row 86 corrected; the owner's cadence decision recorded in DECISIONS.md with the number it was made on

epics.title: Observability baseline (fold: the ERROR-line residual and the alarm-estate ratchet)
epics.outcome: A swallowed 'non-fatal' error is visible within a week with no new metric or alarm; the alarm and metric estate can only shrink or justify; the CloudWatch line's composition is printed every month.
done_when: The weekly sentinel report carries an ERROR-count-by-function section; a planted ERROR line in a checker appears in the next report
The synthesized-template census of Alarm/MetricFilter resources equals the PROPORTIONALITY row count or names the unjustified delta; adding an alarm without a row reds
CTO-2's two unreachable Errors alarms are re-thresholded or deleted and the CloudWatch line moves down the month after

stories.title: Weekly ERROR-line query in the existing drift sentinel, and a shrink-or-justify ratchet on the alarm/metric estate printed by the monthly close
stories.problem: A swallowed AccessDenied logged 'non-fatal' at ERROR for 49 days is invisible to every free instrument; three analysts proposed 4–8 MetricFilters + alarms ($1.50–2.90/mo once custom-metric pricing applies) into an estate of ~120 alarms with four standing reds; CloudWatch grew $4.84 → $31.45 (Mar→Aug) one 'free' alarm at a time; two Errors alarms cannot fire by construction (CTO-2) and nothing ratchets the estate.
stories.outcome: config-drift.yml (or the remediation agent's report) runs one Logs Insights query — `filter level='ERROR' or @message like /AccessDenied|non-fatal/ | stats count() by @log` over /aws/lambda/life-platform-* for 7d — printed with function names. tests/test_alarm_estate_ratchet.py counts Alarm and MetricFilter resources in the synthesized template against PROPORTIONALITY rows (shrink-or-justify); tests/test_alarm_threshold_reachability.py: an AWS/Lambda Errors alarm is threshold 1 or metric-math rate-with-floor, else a dated in-code exemption comment (no traffic registry). monthly_close prints CloudWatch $ and alarm/series counts.
acceptance: Planted ERROR line in freshness-checker's log → named in the next weekly report
Add an alarm in CDK without a PROPORTIONALITY row → red; threshold 3 on a Lambda Errors alarm with no dated exemption → red (CTO-2's two alarms fail today)
Zero new metric series, zero new alarms in the diff (asserted by the ratchet itself)
stories.rent_estimate: $0 standing; Logs Insights <$0.05/mo scan (KB–MB of checker logs); public-repo Actions minutes $0

epics.title: The review as an instrument — frozen anchors, a carry-forward cap, and its own negative control
epics.outcome: A grade means the same thing twice: anchors do not move inside the run that grades against them, no lens is carried forward past 28 days, and a run can be told apart from a blunted verifier.
done_when: Feeding the calendar probe a grades JSON with a 35-day-old unchanged_lenses entry reports 'stale carry-forward: <lens>' instead of green
A run whose verifiers confirm a planted false finding is marked UNCALIBRATED in its own artifact and does not reset the calendar clock
The rubric file's anchor text for a run matches the versioned file at that run's commit (a diff reds the grades JSON shape test)
PROPORTIONALITY carries a row for the review ritual with measured session-hours and tokens per full run

stories.title: Freeze anchors per run, cap carry-forward at 28 days, plant negative controls in the verifier batches, and ledger the review's own cost
stories.problem: 8 of 17 lenses were last graded from scratch on 07-28/08-02 and carried forward through two deltas; the delta selects rows by diff so a reset never selects the narrative row; every one of the 17 A anchors was extended in the run that graded against it (SKILL.md sanctions this), so decay and a raised bar cannot be separated; refutation fell 50%→10% with no calibration; full.md makes finding something a success condition; the review's ~7M-token, multi-hour cost is on no ledger.
stories.outcome: Anchors live in a versioned rubric file frozen for a run and extended only by PR between runs; operating_calendar's probe reads unchanged_lenses ages and forces any row >28d into the next delta; day-of-cycle stays in `method`; each verifier batch carries 2–3 planted false findings and the grader batch 2–3 withheld known issues, with the calibration result recorded in the artifact; B-class path-to-A items are filed or explicitly declined with a reason, never mandatory-filed; a PROPORTIONALITY row for the review with a demote trigger (two consecutive fulls with <10 confirmed findings → quarterly). The reset 'event term' is NOT added while resets are weekly — at most one Day-0 sample of the reset-touching rows per genesis, after the cadence decision.
acceptance: The three negative controls in done_when
full.md/SKILL.md edited: in-run extension removed, 'filed or declined' wording, planted-control procedure
Boot brief prints 'lenses not graded from scratch in >28d: [...]'
